type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {lower upper : Finset (Fin n)},
  ErdosSzekeres.HasDeepBelowSplit χ lower upper →
    ∀ {i j k l : Fin n} (hij : instLTFin.lt i j) (hjk : instLTFin.lt j k) (hkl : instLTFin.lt k l),
      SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instUnion.union lower upper) i →
        SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instUnion.union lower upper) j →
          SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instUnion.union lower upper) k →
            SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instUnion.union lower upper) l →
              Not
                  (And (SetLike.instMembership.mem lower i)
                    (And (SetLike.instMembership.mem lower j)
                      (And (SetLike.instMembership.mem lower k)
                        (SetLike.instMembership.mem lower l)))) →

                      (And (SetLike.instMembership.mem upper j)
                        (And (SetLike.instMembership.mem upper k)
                          (SetLike.instMembership.mem upper l)))) →

                    (χ { i := i, j := j, k := k, hij := hij, hjk := hjk })
                    (χ { i := i, j := j, k := l, hij := hij, hjk := ⋯ })
                    (χ { i := i, j := k, k := l, hij := ⋯, hjk := hkl })

type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {s : Finset (Fin n)},
  ErdosSzekeres.OneChangeOn χ s →
    ∀ {p q y z : Fin n} (hpq : instLTFin.lt p q) (hqy : instLTFin.lt q y) (hyz : instLTFin.lt y z),
      SetLike.instMembership.mem s p →
        SetLike.instMembership.mem s q →
          SetLike.instMembership.mem s y →
            SetLike.instMembership.mem s z →
              Ne (χ { i := p, j := q, k := y, hij := hpq, hjk := hqy })
                  (χ { i := p, j := q, k := z, hij := hpq, hjk := ⋯ }) →
                And
                  (Eq (χ { i := p, j := y, k := z, hij := ⋯, hjk := hyz })
                    (χ { i := p, j := q, k := z, hij := hpq, hjk := ⋯ }))
                  (Eq (χ { i := q, j := y, k := z, hij := hqy, hjk := hyz })
                    (χ { i := p, j := q, k := z, hij := hpq, hjk := ⋯ }))

exact upper bound at `k`. Each color class has at most `2^(k-3)` vertices, so

doc:

bound starts at `k = 3`.
name: ErdosSzekeres.sweepExactUpperAt_three

doc:
A non-strong set has an ordered quadruple meeting every vertex deletion
whose remaining facet is strong.
name: ErdosSzekeres.exists_ordered_quadruple_hitting_strong_deletions
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {s : Finset (Fin n)},
  Not (ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet χ s) →
    Exists fun i =>
      Exists fun j =>
        Exists fun k =>
          Exists fun l =>
            And (instLTFin.lt i j)
              (And (instLTFin.lt j k)
                (And (instLTFin.lt k l)
                  (And (SetLike.instMembership.mem s i)
                    (And (SetLike.instMembership.mem s j)
                      (And (SetLike.instMembership.mem s k)
                        (And (SetLike.instMembership.mem s l)
                          (∀ (d : Fin n),
                            ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet χ (s.erase d) →
                              SetLike.instMembership.mem
                                (Finset.instInsert.insert i
                                  (Finset.instInsert.insert j
                                    (Finset.instInsert.insert k
                                      (Finset.instSingleton.singleton l))))
                                d)))))))

doc:
On at most `2 * k - 3` vertices, strong-`k` avoidance already forces a
predecessor bicoloring.  Below the boundary the two classes can both be made
too small to contain `k-1` vertices.  At equality, failure of every
predecessor set would make every `k`-set strong by the local four-index law.
name: ErdosSzekeres.exists_strongPredecessorBicoloring_of_card_le_two_mul_sub_three
type_pp:
∀ {k : Nat},
  instLENat.le 5 k →
    ∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n},
      instLENat.le n (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul 2 k) 3) →
        Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet χ Finset.univ k) →
          Exists fun red =>
            Exists fun blue =>
              And (Disjoint red blue)
                (And (Eq (Finset.instUnion.union red blue) Finset.univ)
                  (And (Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet χ red (instHSub.hSub k 1)))
                    (Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet χ blue (instHSub.hSub k 1)))))

doc:
On seven ordered labels, four overlapping strong five-sets and the
one-change law force one of the two additional strong five-sets detected by
the seven-local modular discriminator.
name: ErdosSzekeres.seven_ordered_strong_fives_force_disjunction
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {a b c d e f g : Fin n},
  instLTFin.lt a b →
    instLTFin.lt b c →
      instLTFin.lt c d →
        instLTFin.lt d e →
          instLTFin.lt e f →
            instLTFin.lt f g →
              ErdosSzekeres.OneChangeOn χ
                  (Finset.instInsert.insert a
                    (Finset.instInsert.insert b
                      (Finset.instInsert.insert c
                        (Finset.instInsert.insert d
                          (Finset.instInsert.insert e
                            (Finset.instInsert.insert f (Finset.instSingleton.singleton g))))))) →
                ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet χ
                    (Finset.instInsert.insert a
                      (Finset.instInsert.insert c
                        (Finset.instInsert.insert e
                          (Finset.instInsert.insert f (Finset.instSingleton.singleton g))))) →
                  ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet χ
                      (Finset.instInsert.insert a
                        (Finset.instInsert.insert d
                          (Finset.instInsert.insert e
                            (Finset.instInsert.insert f (Finset.instSingleton.singleton g))))) →
                    ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet χ
                        (Finset.instInsert.insert b
                          (Finset.instInsert.insert c
                            (Finset.instInsert.insert d
                              (Finset.instInsert.insert f (Finset.instSingleton.singleton g))))) →
                      ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet χ
                          (Finset.instInsert.insert b
                            (Finset.instInsert.insert c
                              (Finset.instInsert.insert e
                                (Finset.instInsert.insert f (Finset.instSingleton.singleton g))))) →
                        Or
                          (ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet χ
                            (Finset.instInsert.insert a
                              (Finset.instInsert.insert b
                                (Finset.instInsert.insert e
                                  (Finset.instInsert.insert f
                                    (Finset.instSingleton.singleton g))))))
                          (ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet χ
                            (Finset.instInsert.insert b
                              (Finset.instInsert.insert d
                                (Finset.instInsert.insert e
                                  (Finset.instInsert.insert f
                                    (Finset.instSingleton.singleton g))))))

doc:
If every predecessor-sized subset of a set with at least five vertices is
strong, then the whole set is strong.  Every ordered quadruple survives after
erasing some fifth vertex, so the four-index law is inherited from a
predecessor subset.
name: ErdosSzekeres.isStrongPolygonSet_of_all_pred_subsets
type_pp:
∀ {n k : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {s : Finset (Fin n)},
  instLENat.le 5 k →
    Eq s.card k →
      (∀ (t : Finset (Fin n)),
          Finset.instHasSubset.Subset t s →
            Eq t.card (instHSub.hSub k 1) → ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet χ t) →
        ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet χ s

doc:
One predecessor-free support containing at least half of the vertices
gives the same exact doubling recurrence as a full predecessor bicoloring.
name: ErdosSzekeres.sweepExactUpperAt_of_predecessorHalfSubset
type_pp:
∀ {k : Nat},
  instLENat.le 4 k →
    ErdosSzekeres.SweepExactUpperAt (instHSub.hSub k 1) →
      ErdosSzekeres.PredecessorHalfSubsetAt k → ErdosSzekeres.SweepExactUpperAt k

doc:
A fractional predecessor cover gives the same exact doubling recurrence
as an integral bicoloring. The proof is finite rational double counting: each
positive-weight predecessor-free support has bounded cardinality, while the
cover supplies total vertex incidence at least the ambient cardinality.
name: ErdosSzekeres.sweepExactUpperAt_of_fractionalPredecessorCover
type_pp:
∀ {k : Nat},
  instLENat.le 4 k →
    ErdosSzekeres.SweepExactUpperAt (instHSub.hSub k 1) →
      ErdosSzekeres.FractionalPredecessorCoverAt k → ErdosSzekeres.SweepExactUpperAt k

doc:
At most three vertices of a non-strong set of cardinality at least five
have a strong deletion facet.  Four such deletions would be the four vertices
of a bad quadruple; a fifth ambient vertex then repairs both failed
equalities.
name: ErdosSzekeres.strong_deletions_card_le_three_of_five_le
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {s deletions : Finset (Fin n)},
  instLENat.le 5 s.card →
    Not (ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet χ s) →
      (∀ (d : Fin n),
          SetLike.instMembership.mem deletions d → ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet χ (s.erase d)) →
        instLENat.le deletions.card 3

doc:
Structural resource at the first non-index-one saturated boundary.

An upper child larger than the classical `(3,6)` threshold contains a
three-cap unless it already contains a parent six-cup. If the parent also has
no four-cap, that three-cap's interval covers every lower-child vertex. No
finite state-466/566 theorem or certificate is used.

type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {lower upper : Finset (Fin n)},
  ErdosSzekeres.IsSweepRealizable χ →
    ErdosSzekeres.HasDeepBelowSplit χ lower upper →
      instLTNat.lt 5 upper.card →
        Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCapSet χ (Finset.instUnion.union lower upper) 4) →
          Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCupSet χ (Finset.instUnion.union lower upper) 6) →
            Exists fun cap =>
              ∀ (q : Fin n),
                SetLike.instMembership.mem lower q →
                  (ErdosSzekeres.finsetSweepInterval cap.val ⋯).StraddlesCut q.val

the sweep interval of each upper `a`-cap.  This is the arbitrary-lower-child
form of the common-cut resource; it does not assume the lower child is a
singleton or contiguous in sweep order.

      Not

            (instHAdd.hAdd a 1)) →
        ∀ (hcap : SetLike.instMembership.mem (ErdosSzekeres.capWitnesses χ upper a) cap)
          (q : Fin n),
          SetLike.instMembership.mem lower q →
            (ErdosSzekeres.finsetSweepInterval cap ⋯).StraddlesCut q.val

doc:
The singleton-root charge has exactly the desired numerical strength: it
replaces the independent-side bound `23` by the diagonal threshold `16`.

type_pp:
ErdosSzekeres.SingletonRootSeparatedCapChargeAtSix →
  ∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {upper earlier later : Finset (Fin n)}
    {q : Fin n},
    ErdosSzekeres.IsDecomposableOn χ upper →
      ErdosSzekeres.HasDeepBelowSplit χ (Finset.instSingleton.singleton q) upper →
        Finset.instHasSubset.Subset earlier upper →
          Finset.instHasSubset.Subset later upper →
            Eq earlier.card 4 →
              Eq later.card 4 →
                ErdosSzekeres.IsCapSet χ earlier →
                  ErdosSzekeres.IsCapSet χ later →
                    ErdosSzekeres.FinsetWeaklyBefore earlier later →
                      Not
                          (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCapSet χ
                            (Finset.instUnion.union (Finset.instSingleton.singleton q) upper) 5) →
                        Not
                            (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCupSet χ
                              (Finset.instUnion.union (Finset.instSingleton.singleton q) upper) 6) →
                          Not
                              (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet χ
                                (Finset.instUnion.union (Finset.instSingleton.singleton q) upper)
                                6) →
                            instLENat.le
                              (Finset.instUnion.union (Finset.instSingleton.singleton q) upper).card
                              16

      ∀ (q : Fin n),
        instLENat.le

doc:
Ordered crossing caps at a deep-below split use lower-child endpoint ports,
share a port only in the forced right/left directions, and have multiplicity
at most two at each lower vertex.
name: ErdosSzekeres.HasDeepBelowSplit.ordered_crossing_caps_lower_port_capacity
type_pp:
∀ {m n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {lower upper : Finset (Fin n)},
  ErdosSzekeres.HasDeepBelowSplit χ lower upper →
    ∀ (caps : Fin m → Finset (Fin n)),
      (∀ (i : Fin m), Finset.instHasSubset.Subset (caps i) (Finset.instUnion.union lower upper)) →
        (∀ (i : Fin m), instLENat.le 2 (caps i).card) →
          (∀ (i : Fin m), ErdosSzekeres.IsCapSet χ (caps i)) →
            (∀ (i : Fin m), (Finset.instInter.inter (caps i) lower).Nonempty) →
              (∀ (i : Fin m), (Finset.instInter.inter (caps i) upper).Nonempty) →
                (∀ {i j : Fin m},
                    instLTFin.lt i j → ErdosSzekeres.FinsetWeaklyBefore (caps i) (caps j)) →
                  And
                    (∀ (i : Fin m) (q : Fin n),
                      SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instInter.inter (caps i) lower) q →
                        ErdosSzekeres.HasDeepBelowSplit.IsSweepEndpoint (caps i) q)
                    (And
                      (∀ {i j : Fin m} {q : Fin n},
                        instLTFin.lt i j →
                          SetLike.instMembership.mem (caps i) q →
                            SetLike.instMembership.mem (caps j) q →
                              And (ErdosSzekeres.HasDeepBelowSplit.IsRightSweepEndpoint (caps i) q)
                                (ErdosSzekeres.HasDeepBelowSplit.IsLeftSweepEndpoint (caps j) q))
                      (∀ (q : Fin n),
                        SetLike.instMembership.mem lower q →
                          instLENat.le
                            (Finset.filter (fun i => SetLike.instMembership.mem (caps i) q)
                                Finset.univ).card
                            2))

no-strong-`k` context this excludes a complementary upper-child cap.

type_pp:
∀ {n rank k : Nat} {chi : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {lower upper : Finset (Fin n)}

    SetLike.instMembership.mem
        (ErdosSzekeres.allocatedExactRankFrontier chi lower upper ErdosSzekeres.Turn.left rank)
        span →
      instLENat.le 1 rank →
        Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet chi (Finset.instUnion.union lower upper) k) →
          And (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCupSet chi lower (instHSub.hSub rank 1))

    (SetLike.instMembership.mem (ErdosSzekeres.allocatedExactRankSpans chi lower upper color rank)
      span)

      (ErdosSzekeres.HasExactSpanRank color chi (Finset.instUnion.union lower upper) span rank))

doc:
At the boundary rank two, exactness has a direct order-theoretic normal
form.  A crossing cup span is exact precisely when no lower-child vertex lies
strictly inside it; dually, a crossing cap span excludes upper-child interior
vertices.

type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {chi : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {lower upper : Finset (Fin n)}

    Iff
      (SetLike.instMembership.mem (ErdosSzekeres.allocatedExactRankSpans chi lower upper color 2)
        span)
      (And (span.CrossesSplit lower upper)
        (∀ (q : Fin n),
          SetLike.instMembership.mem (ErdosSzekeres.rankTwoActiveChild lower upper color) q →
            Not (And (instLTFin.lt span.left q) (instLTFin.lt q span.right))))

∀ {n cupRank capRank k : Nat} {chi : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {lower upper : Finset (Fin n)}

doc:

form.

type_pp:

branch.  The conserved endpoint owner and this active pivot are deliberately
distinct fields.
name: ErdosSzekeres.PublishedBranchPivotResource
type_pp:
{n : Nat} →
  {a u k : Nat} →
    {lower upper : Finset (Fin n)} →
      (branch : ErdosSzekeres.PublishedSaturatedBranch) →
        ErdosSzekeres.HiddenGapSource lower upper branch.promotedColor → Type

name: ErdosSzekeres.PublishedBranchPivotResource.upper.noConfusion
type_pp:
{n a u k : Nat} →
  {lower upper : Finset (Fin n)} →
    {P : Sort u} →
      {source : ErdosSzekeres.HiddenGapSource lower upper ErdosSzekeres.Turn.right} →
        {pivot : Fin n} →
          {pivot_mem_child : SetLike.instMembership.mem upper pivot} →
            {left_lt_pivot : instLTFin.lt source.val.left pivot} →
              {pivot_lt_right : instLTFin.lt pivot source.val.right} →
                {slice : ErdosSzekeres.PublishedCapChildSlice a u k upper} →
                  {pivot_mem_core : SetLike.instMembership.mem slice.core pivot} →
                    {source' : ErdosSzekeres.HiddenGapSource lower upper ErdosSzekeres.Turn.right} →
                      {pivot' : Fin n} →
                        {pivot_mem_child' : SetLike.instMembership.mem upper pivot'} →
                          {left_lt_pivot' : instLTFin.lt source'.val.left pivot'} →
                            {pivot_lt_right' : instLTFin.lt pivot' source'.val.right} →
                              {slice' : ErdosSzekeres.PublishedCapChildSlice a u k upper} →
                                {pivot_mem_core' : SetLike.instMembership.mem slice'.core pivot'} →
                                  Eq source source' →
                                    HEq
                                        (ErdosSzekeres.PublishedBranchPivotResource.upper source
                                          pivot pivot_mem_child left_lt_pivot pivot_lt_right slice
                                          pivot_mem_core)
                                        (ErdosSzekeres.PublishedBranchPivotResource.upper source'
                                          pivot' pivot_mem_child' left_lt_pivot' pivot_lt_right'
                                          slice' pivot_mem_core') →
                                      (HEq source source' →
                                          HEq pivot pivot' → HEq slice slice' → P) →
                                        P

doc:
The color-dual capacity estimate likewise puts all upper-branch pivots in
one simultaneously chosen retained core.
name: ErdosSzekeres.exists_publishedUpperPivotSlice_of_card_le
type_pp:
∀ {n a u k : Nat} {lower upper : Finset (Fin n)},
  instLENat.le 1 a →
    upper.Nonempty →
      Disjoint lower upper →
        instLENat.le
            (Fintype.card (ErdosSzekeres.HiddenGapSource lower upper ErdosSzekeres.Turn.right))
            (instHAdd.hAdd
              (ErdosSzekeres.decomposableThreshold
                (ErdosSzekeres.publishedCapChildIndex a u k upper.card) u k)
              1) →
          Exists fun slice =>
            ∀ (source : ErdosSzekeres.HiddenGapSource lower upper ErdosSzekeres.Turn.right),
              SetLike.instMembership.mem slice.core source.enteringPivot

name: ErdosSzekeres.HiddenGapSource.enteringPivot_between
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {lower upper : Finset (Fin n)} {color : ErdosSzekeres.Turn}
  (source : ErdosSzekeres.HiddenGapSource lower upper color),
  And (instLTFin.lt source.val.left source.enteringPivot)
    (instLTFin.lt source.enteringPivot source.val.right)

doc:
Forget that a hidden lower gap is hidden and retain its lower-child
adjacency.
name: ErdosSzekeres.hiddenLowerGapSourceAdjacencyEmbedding
type_pp:
{n : Nat} →
  (lower upper : Finset (Fin n)) →
    Function.Embedding (ErdosSzekeres.HiddenGapSource lower upper ErdosSzekeres.Turn.right)
      (ErdosSzekeres.SweepAdjacency lower)

doc: Hidden lower gaps satisfy the color-dual source-child bound.
name: ErdosSzekeres.hiddenLowerGapSource_card_le
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} (lower upper : Finset (Fin n)),
  lower.Nonempty →
    instLENat.le (Fintype.card (ErdosSzekeres.HiddenGapSource lower upper ErdosSzekeres.Turn.right))
      (instHSub.hSub lower.card 1)

doc:
Hence branch-compatible pivots have the first necessary local nonreuse
bound.  Fitting all of them in one retained core requires a sharper bound.
name: ErdosSzekeres.publishedBranchPivot_card_le_child_card
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {lower upper : Finset (Fin n)},
  Disjoint lower upper →
    ∀ (branch : ErdosSzekeres.PublishedSaturatedBranch),
      instLENat.le (Fintype.card (ErdosSzekeres.HiddenGapSource lower upper branch.promotedColor))
        (ErdosSzekeres.PublishedSaturatedBranch.child lower upper branch).card

doc: The finite set of canonical pivots used by one promoted color.
name: ErdosSzekeres.hiddenGapEnteringPivotSeed
type_pp: {n : Nat} → Finset (Fin n) → Finset (Fin n) → ErdosSzekeres.Turn → Finset (Fin n)

name: ErdosSzekeres.PublishedBranchPivotResource.noConfusion
type_pp:
{P : Sort u} →
  {n a u k : Nat} →
    {lower upper : Finset (Fin n)} →
      {branch : ErdosSzekeres.PublishedSaturatedBranch} →
        {a_1 : ErdosSzekeres.HiddenGapSource lower upper branch.promotedColor} →
          {t : ErdosSzekeres.PublishedBranchPivotResource branch a_1} →
            {n' a' u' k' : Nat} →
              {lower' upper' : Finset (Fin n')} →
                {branch' : ErdosSzekeres.PublishedSaturatedBranch} →
                  {a'_1 : ErdosSzekeres.HiddenGapSource lower' upper' branch'.promotedColor} →
                    {t' : ErdosSzekeres.PublishedBranchPivotResource branch' a'_1} →
                      Eq n n' →
                        Eq a a' →
                          Eq u u' →
                            Eq k k' →
                              HEq lower lower' →
                                HEq upper upper' →
                                  Eq branch branch' →
                                    HEq a_1 a'_1 →
                                      HEq t t' →
                                        ErdosSzekeres.PublishedBranchPivotResource.noConfusionType P
                                          t t'

name: ErdosSzekeres.PublishedBranchPivotResource.recOn
type_pp:
{n a u k : Nat} →
  {lower upper : Finset (Fin n)} →
    {motive :
        (branch : ErdosSzekeres.PublishedSaturatedBranch) →
          (a_1 : ErdosSzekeres.HiddenGapSource lower upper branch.promotedColor) →
            ErdosSzekeres.PublishedBranchPivotResource branch a_1 → Sort u} →
      {branch : ErdosSzekeres.PublishedSaturatedBranch} →
        {a_1 : ErdosSzekeres.HiddenGapSource lower upper branch.promotedColor} →
          (t : ErdosSzekeres.PublishedBranchPivotResource branch a_1) →
            ((source : ErdosSzekeres.HiddenGapSource lower upper ErdosSzekeres.Turn.left) →
                (pivot : Fin n) →
                  (pivot_mem_child : SetLike.instMembership.mem lower pivot) →
                    (left_lt_pivot : instLTFin.lt source.val.left pivot) →
                      (pivot_lt_right : instLTFin.lt pivot source.val.right) →
                        (slice : ErdosSzekeres.PublishedChildSlice a u k lower) →
                          (pivot_mem_core : SetLike.instMembership.mem slice.core pivot) →
                            motive ErdosSzekeres.PublishedSaturatedBranch.lower source
                              (ErdosSzekeres.PublishedBranchPivotResource.lower source pivot
                                pivot_mem_child left_lt_pivot pivot_lt_right slice
                                pivot_mem_core)) →
              ((source : ErdosSzekeres.HiddenGapSource lower upper ErdosSzekeres.Turn.right) →
                  (pivot : Fin n) →
                    (pivot_mem_child : SetLike.instMembership.mem upper pivot) →
                      (left_lt_pivot : instLTFin.lt source.val.left pivot) →
                        (pivot_lt_right : instLTFin.lt pivot source.val.right) →
                          (slice : ErdosSzekeres.PublishedCapChildSlice a u k upper) →
                            (pivot_mem_core : SetLike.instMembership.mem slice.core pivot) →
                              motive ErdosSzekeres.PublishedSaturatedBranch.upper source
                                (ErdosSzekeres.PublishedBranchPivotResource.upper source pivot
                                  pivot_mem_child left_lt_pivot pivot_lt_right slice
                                  pivot_mem_core)) →
                motive branch a_1 t

doc:
The promoted hidden-gap color whose intervening pivot lies in the branch:
hidden upper gaps promote cups into the lower branch, while hidden lower gaps
promote caps into the upper branch.
name: ErdosSzekeres.PublishedSaturatedBranch.promotedColor

doc:
The canonical pivot lies in the child opposite the hidden gap: lower for
a hidden upper gap, and upper for a hidden lower gap.
name: ErdosSzekeres.HiddenGapSource.enteringPivot_mem_oppositeChild
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {lower upper : Finset (Fin n)} {color : ErdosSzekeres.Turn}
  (source : ErdosSzekeres.HiddenGapSource lower upper color),
  Disjoint lower upper →
    ErdosSzekeres.HiddenGapSource.enteringPivot_mem_oppositeChild.match_1 (fun color source => Prop)
      color source (fun source => SetLike.instMembership.mem lower source.enteringPivot)
      fun source => SetLike.instMembership.mem upper source.enteringPivot

name: ErdosSzekeres.PublishedBranchPivotResource.lower.sizeOf_spec
type_pp:
∀ {n a u k : Nat} {lower upper : Finset (Fin n)}
  (source : ErdosSzekeres.HiddenGapSource lower upper ErdosSzekeres.Turn.left) (pivot : Fin n)
  (pivot_mem_child : SetLike.instMembership.mem lower pivot)
  (left_lt_pivot : instLTFin.lt source.val.left pivot)
  (pivot_lt_right : instLTFin.lt pivot source.val.right)
  (slice : ErdosSzekeres.PublishedChildSlice a u k lower)
  (pivot_mem_core : SetLike.instMembership.mem slice.core pivot),
  Eq
    ((ErdosSzekeres.PublishedBranchPivotResource._sizeOf_inst
          ErdosSzekeres.PublishedSaturatedBranch.lower source).sizeOf
      (ErdosSzekeres.PublishedBranchPivotResource.lower source pivot pivot_mem_child left_lt_pivot
        pivot_lt_right slice pivot_mem_core))
    (instHAdd.hAdd
      (instHAdd.hAdd
        (instHAdd.hAdd
          (instHAdd.hAdd
            (instHAdd.hAdd
              (instHAdd.hAdd
                (instHAdd.hAdd 1
                  ((Subtype._sizeOf_inst fun span =>
                        SetLike.instMembership.mem
                          (ErdosSzekeres.hiddenGapSources lower upper ErdosSzekeres.Turn.left)
                          span).sizeOf
                    source))
                ((Fin._sizeOf_inst n).sizeOf pivot))
              ((instSizeOfDefault (SetLike.instMembership.mem lower pivot)).sizeOf pivot_mem_child))
            ((instSizeOfDefault (instLTFin.lt source.val.left pivot)).sizeOf left_lt_pivot))
          ((instSizeOfDefault (instLTFin.lt pivot source.val.right)).sizeOf pivot_lt_right))
        ((ErdosSzekeres.PublishedChildSlice._sizeOf_inst a u k lower).sizeOf slice))
      ((instSizeOfDefault (SetLike.instMembership.mem slice.core pivot)).sizeOf pivot_mem_core))

doc:
Color-dually, a nonempty upper child, no parent four-cup, and no parent
`a`-cap bound all hidden upper sources strictly by `a`.
name: ErdosSzekeres.hiddenUpperGapSource_card_lt_of_no_cup_four_no_cap
type_pp:
∀ {n a : Nat} {chi : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {lower upper : Finset (Fin n)},
  ErdosSzekeres.HasDeepBelowSplit chi lower upper →
    upper.Nonempty →
      Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCupSet chi (Finset.instUnion.union lower upper) 4) →
        Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCapSet chi (Finset.instUnion.union lower upper) a) →
          instLTNat.lt
            (Fintype.card (ErdosSzekeres.HiddenGapSource lower upper ErdosSzekeres.Turn.left)) a

doc:
Equality in the hidden-gap count upgrades the pivot injection to an
embedding of every lower adjacency into actual upper-child vertices.
name: ErdosSzekeres.hiddenLowerGapAdjacencyPivotEmbedding
type_pp:
{n : Nat} →
  {lower upper : Finset (Fin n)} →
    Disjoint lower upper →
      Eq (Fintype.card (ErdosSzekeres.HiddenGapSource lower upper ErdosSzekeres.Turn.right))
          (Fintype.card (ErdosSzekeres.SweepAdjacency lower)) →
        Function.Embedding (ErdosSzekeres.SweepAdjacency lower)
          (ErdosSzekeres.RetainedVertexOwner upper)

doc:
Thirteen upper vertices have published cap index three at the normalized
`(4,8,8)` boundary.
name: ErdosSzekeres.publishedCapChildIndex_eq_three_at_488_thirteen

doc:
At equality in the source-adjacency count, forgetting hiddenness is a
bijection onto all source-child adjacencies.
name: ErdosSzekeres.hiddenLowerGapSourceAdjacencyEmbedding_bijective_of_card_eq
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {lower upper : Finset (Fin n)},
  Eq (Fintype.card (ErdosSzekeres.HiddenGapSource lower upper ErdosSzekeres.Turn.right))
      (Fintype.card (ErdosSzekeres.SweepAdjacency lower)) →
    Function.Bijective
      (Function.instFunLikeEmbedding.coe
        (ErdosSzekeres.hiddenLowerGapSourceAdjacencyEmbedding lower upper))

doc:
The exact `10+13` overflow therefore yields a nine-element family of
pairwise distinct upper pivots, with one pivot inside every lower adjacency.
name: ErdosSzekeres.k8_hiddenLowerGapPivotSkeleton
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {lower upper : Finset (Fin n)},
  lower.Nonempty →
    Eq lower.card 10 →
      Eq upper.card 13 →
        Disjoint lower upper →
          instLENat.le 9
              (Fintype.card (ErdosSzekeres.HiddenGapSource lower upper ErdosSzekeres.Turn.right)) →
            Exists fun pivot =>
              And (Eq (Fintype.card (ErdosSzekeres.SweepAdjacency lower)) 9)
                (∀ (gap : ErdosSzekeres.SweepAdjacency lower),
                  And (instLTFin.lt gap.val.left (Function.instFunLikeEmbedding.coe pivot gap).val)
                    (instLTFin.lt (Function.instFunLikeEmbedding.coe pivot gap).val gap.val.right))

doc:
Equality means that every lower adjacency is hidden, not merely that the
two finite types have the same size.
name: ErdosSzekeres.every_lower_adjacency_hidden_of_card_eq
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {lower upper : Finset (Fin n)},
  Eq (Fintype.card (ErdosSzekeres.HiddenGapSource lower upper ErdosSzekeres.Turn.right))
      (Fintype.card (ErdosSzekeres.SweepAdjacency lower)) →
    ∀ (gap : ErdosSzekeres.SweepAdjacency lower), ErdosSzekeres.IsHiddenLowerGap lower upper gap.val

doc:
Color-dually, the same cone mechanism exactly pays a selected lower core
whose published cup index is three.
name: ErdosSzekeres.hiddenUpperGapSource_card_le_cup_index_three_capacity
type_pp:
∀ {n a k : Nat} {chi : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {lower upper : Finset (Fin n)},
  ErdosSzekeres.HasDeepBelowSplit chi lower upper →
    upper.Nonempty →
      instLENat.le 2 a →
        instLENat.le a k →
          Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCapSet chi (Finset.instUnion.union lower upper) a) →
            Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCupSet chi (Finset.instUnion.union lower upper) 4) →
              instLENat.le
                (Fintype.card (ErdosSzekeres.HiddenGapSource lower upper ErdosSzekeres.Turn.left))
                (instHAdd.hAdd (ErdosSzekeres.decomposableThreshold a 3 k) 1)

doc:
Cardinal equality in a form convenient for transporting geometric facts
from hidden sources to every lower adjacency.
name: ErdosSzekeres.k8_hiddenLowerGapSource_card_eq_sweepAdjacency
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {lower upper : Finset (Fin n)},
  lower.Nonempty →
    Eq lower.card 10 →
      instLENat.le 9
          (Fintype.card (ErdosSzekeres.HiddenGapSource lower upper ErdosSzekeres.Turn.right)) →
        Eq (Fintype.card (ErdosSzekeres.HiddenGapSource lower upper ErdosSzekeres.Turn.right))
          (Fintype.card (ErdosSzekeres.SweepAdjacency lower))

doc:
Every canonical pivot for a hidden lower gap lies in the upper child and
strictly to the right of the minimum lower vertex.
name: ErdosSzekeres.hiddenLowerGapEnteringPivotSeed_subset_upper_right_of_min
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {chi : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {lower upper : Finset (Fin n)},
  ErdosSzekeres.HasDeepBelowSplit chi lower upper →
    ∀ (hlower : lower.Nonempty),
      Finset.instHasSubset.Subset
        (ErdosSzekeres.hiddenGapEnteringPivotSeed lower upper ErdosSzekeres.Turn.right)
        (Finset.filter (fun x => instLTFin.lt (lower.min' hlower) x) upper)

doc:
Hence the source-forgetting map is bijective in the normalized `10+13`
overflow state.  The upper-cardinality equation is recorded because it is the
actual first saturated split, although it is not needed for this conclusion.
name: ErdosSzekeres.k8_hiddenLowerGapSourceAdjacencyEmbedding_bijective
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {lower upper : Finset (Fin n)},
  lower.Nonempty →
    Eq lower.card 10 →
      Eq upper.card 13 →
        instLENat.le 9
            (Fintype.card (ErdosSzekeres.HiddenGapSource lower upper ErdosSzekeres.Turn.right)) →
          Function.Bijective
            (Function.instFunLikeEmbedding.coe
              (ErdosSzekeres.hiddenLowerGapSourceAdjacencyEmbedding lower upper))

doc:
The canonical upper pivot assigned to a lower adjacency once equality has
made every lower adjacency a hidden source.
name: ErdosSzekeres.hiddenLowerGapAdjacencyPivot
type_pp:
{n : Nat} →
  (lower upper : Finset (Fin n)) →
    Eq (Fintype.card (ErdosSzekeres.HiddenGapSource lower upper ErdosSzekeres.Turn.right))
        (Fintype.card (ErdosSzekeres.SweepAdjacency lower)) →
      ErdosSzekeres.SweepAdjacency lower → Fin n

doc:
Consequently, no parent four-cap and no parent `u`-cup give a direct
strict bound on all hidden lower sources.  This bypasses the coarse
source-child adjacency estimate.
name: ErdosSzekeres.hiddenLowerGapSource_card_lt_of_no_cap_four_no_cup
type_pp:
∀ {n u : Nat} {chi : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {lower upper : Finset (Fin n)},
  ErdosSzekeres.HasDeepBelowSplit chi lower upper →
    lower.Nonempty →
      Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCapSet chi (Finset.instUnion.union lower upper) 4) →
        Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCupSet chi (Finset.instUnion.union lower upper) u) →
          instLTNat.lt
            (Fintype.card (ErdosSzekeres.HiddenGapSource lower upper ErdosSzekeres.Turn.right)) u

doc:
The geometry-sensitive bound closes the actual selected-core obligation:
all hidden-lower canonical pivots fit simultaneously in one published
eight-vertex upper core.
name: ErdosSzekeres.exists_publishedUpperPivotSlice_open_488_thirteen
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {chi : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {lower upper : Finset (Fin n)},
  ErdosSzekeres.HasDeepBelowSplit chi lower upper →
    lower.Nonempty →
      upper.Nonempty →
        Eq upper.card 13 →
          Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCapSet chi (Finset.instUnion.union lower upper) 4) →
            Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCupSet chi (Finset.instUnion.union lower upper) 8) →
              Exists fun slice =>
                ∀ (source : ErdosSzekeres.HiddenGapSource lower upper ErdosSzekeres.Turn.right),
                  SetLike.instMembership.mem slice.core source.enteringPivot

doc:
At the first scalar leak this gives seven pivots at most, already below
the selected upper core's eight-vertex capacity.
name: ErdosSzekeres.hiddenLowerGapSource_card_le_488_upper_core_capacity
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {chi : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {lower upper : Finset (Fin n)},
  ErdosSzekeres.HasDeepBelowSplit chi lower upper →
    lower.Nonempty →
      Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCapSet chi (Finset.instUnion.union lower upper) 4) →
        Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCupSet chi (Finset.instUnion.union lower upper) 8) →
          instLENat.le
            (Fintype.card (ErdosSzekeres.HiddenGapSource lower upper ErdosSzekeres.Turn.right))
            (instHAdd.hAdd (ErdosSzekeres.decomposableThreshold 3 8 8) 1)

doc:
The cone bound exactly pays any selected upper core whose published cap
index is three, uniformly in `u ≤ k`.
name: ErdosSzekeres.hiddenLowerGapSource_card_le_cap_index_three_capacity
type_pp:
∀ {n u k : Nat} {chi : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {lower upper : Finset (Fin n)},
  ErdosSzekeres.HasDeepBelowSplit chi lower upper →
    lower.Nonempty →
      instLENat.le 2 u →
        instLENat.le u k →
          Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCapSet chi (Finset.instUnion.union lower upper) 4) →
            Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCupSet chi (Finset.instUnion.union lower upper) u) →
              instLENat.le
                (Fintype.card (ErdosSzekeres.HiddenGapSource lower upper ErdosSzekeres.Turn.right))
                (instHAdd.hAdd (ErdosSzekeres.decomposableThreshold 3 u k) 1)

doc:
A lower extreme acts as a common cone point for the whole hidden-lower
pivot seed.  If the parent has no four-cap, the upper vertices to the right of
that anchor—and therefore the pivot seed—form a cup.
name: ErdosSzekeres.hiddenLowerGapEnteringPivotSeed_isCupSet_of_no_cap_four
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {chi : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {lower upper : Finset (Fin n)},
  ErdosSzekeres.HasDeepBelowSplit chi lower upper →
    lower.Nonempty →
      Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCapSet chi (Finset.instUnion.union lower upper) 4) →
        ErdosSzekeres.IsCupSet chi
          (ErdosSzekeres.hiddenGapEnteringPivotSeed lower upper ErdosSzekeres.Turn.right)

doc:
Each pivot supplied by the extremal equality lies strictly between the
endpoints of the lower adjacency it represents.
name: ErdosSzekeres.hiddenLowerGapAdjacencyPivot_between
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {lower upper : Finset (Fin n)}
  (hcard :
    Eq (Fintype.card (ErdosSzekeres.HiddenGapSource lower upper ErdosSzekeres.Turn.right))
      (Fintype.card (ErdosSzekeres.SweepAdjacency lower)))
  (gap : ErdosSzekeres.SweepAdjacency lower),
  And (instLTFin.lt gap.val.left (ErdosSzekeres.hiddenLowerGapAdjacencyPivot lower upper hcard gap))
    (instLTFin.lt (ErdosSzekeres.hiddenLowerGapAdjacencyPivot lower upper hcard gap) gap.val.right)

doc:
The color-dual published cup index three has exactly `a` retained
vertices.
name: ErdosSzekeres.decomposableThreshold_three_right_add_one_eq
type_pp:
∀ {a k : Nat},
  instLENat.le 2 a →
    instLENat.le a k → Eq (instHAdd.hAdd (ErdosSzekeres.decomposableThreshold a 3 k) 1) a

doc:
The resulting canonical equivalence between hidden lower sources and all
lower sweep adjacencies.
name: ErdosSzekeres.hiddenLowerGapSourceAdjacencyEquiv
type_pp:
{n : Nat} →
  (lower upper : Finset (Fin n)) →
    Eq (Fintype.card (ErdosSzekeres.HiddenGapSource lower upper ErdosSzekeres.Turn.right))
        (Fintype.card (ErdosSzekeres.SweepAdjacency lower)) →
      Equiv (ErdosSzekeres.HiddenGapSource lower upper ErdosSzekeres.Turn.right)
        (ErdosSzekeres.SweepAdjacency lower)

name: ErdosSzekeres.hiddenLowerGapSourceAdjacencyEquiv.congr_simp
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} (lower upper : Finset (Fin n))
  (hcard :
    Eq (Fintype.card (ErdosSzekeres.HiddenGapSource lower upper ErdosSzekeres.Turn.right))
      (Fintype.card (ErdosSzekeres.SweepAdjacency lower))),
  Eq (ErdosSzekeres.hiddenLowerGapSourceAdjacencyEquiv lower upper hcard)
    (ErdosSzekeres.hiddenLowerGapSourceAdjacencyEquiv lower upper hcard)

doc:
In particular, every one of the nine lower adjacencies has a unique hidden
source in the normalized overflow state.
name: ErdosSzekeres.k8_every_lower_adjacency_has_unique_hidden_source
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {lower upper : Finset (Fin n)},
  lower.Nonempty →
    Eq lower.card 10 →
      Eq upper.card 13 →
        instLENat.le 9
            (Fintype.card (ErdosSzekeres.HiddenGapSource lower upper ErdosSzekeres.Turn.right)) →
          ∀ (gap : ErdosSzekeres.SweepAdjacency lower),
            ExistsUnique fun source =>
              Eq
                (Function.instFunLikeEmbedding.coe
                  (ErdosSzekeres.hiddenLowerGapSourceAdjacencyEmbedding lower upper) source)
                gap

doc:
At the first scalar obstruction, nine possible hidden lower gaps are
necessarily exactly all nine adjacencies of the ten-vertex lower child.
name: ErdosSzekeres.k8_hiddenLowerGapSource_card_eq_nine
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {lower upper : Finset (Fin n)},

type_pp:
∀ {k : Nat},
  instLENat.le 5 k →
    ErdosSzekeres.DiagonalCupBlocksForce4kk k →
      ∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {left right : Finset (Fin n)},
        Disjoint left right →

              SetLike.instMembership.mem left x →
                ∀ (y : Fin n), SetLike.instMembership.mem right y → instLTFin.lt x y) →
            ErdosSzekeres.IsCupSet χ left →
              ErdosSzekeres.IsCupSet χ right →
                ErdosSzekeres.OneChangeOn χ (Finset.instUnion.union left right) →
                  Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCapSet χ (Finset.instUnion.union left right) 4) →

                      Not

when the whole coloring is recursively decomposable.

type_pp:

doc: The number of decomposition-prime restrictions of a coloring.
name: ErdosSzekeres.PrimeCoreCount

doc:

the colors of triples inside that support.

∀ {n : Nat} {χ ψ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {support : Finset (Fin n)},
  χ.AgreeOnTriples ψ support →
    Iff (ErdosSzekeres.HasProperDeepBelowSplitOn χ support)
      (ErdosSzekeres.HasProperDeepBelowSplitOn ψ support)

doc:
Recursive decomposability transfers between colorings that agree on the
entire support.

    χ.AgreeOnTriples ψ support → ErdosSzekeres.IsDecomposableOn ψ support

doc:
The number of decomposition-prime restrictions having a specified
cardinality. This is one coordinate of the cardinality-stratified rank.

doc:
The geometric obligation for the stratified Layer-F route: above the
exact threshold, every target-free realizable nondecomposable coloring has an
at-most-three-mutation endpoint whose highest changed prime-core stratum
strictly decreases.  Intermediate ranks are intentionally unconstrained.
name: ErdosSzekeres.ThreeStepTopPrimeStratumDropsAboveAt

doc:
A top-stratum mutation macro supplies the concrete natural-valued rank
descent required by the normalization theorem.
name: ErdosSzekeres.threeStepMutationRankDescendsAbove_of_topPrimeStratumDrop
type_pp:
∀ {k : Nat},
  ErdosSzekeres.ThreeStepTopPrimeStratumDropsAboveAt k →
    ErdosSzekeres.ThreeStepMutationRankDescendsAboveAt k fun x χ =>
      ErdosSzekeres.StratifiedPrimeCoreRank χ

doc:
If the first changed cardinality stratum, read from largest to smallest,
loses a prime core, then the stratified rank strictly decreases.  The base
`2^n+1` makes the total contribution of every lower support too small to
cancel one lost core at the distinguished stratum.
name: ErdosSzekeres.stratifiedPrimeCoreRank_lt_of_topStratumDrop
type_pp:
∀ {n m : Nat} {χ ψ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n},
  instLTNat.lt 0 m →
    (∀ (support : Finset (Fin n)),
        instLTNat.lt m support.card →
          Iff (SetLike.instMembership.mem (ErdosSzekeres.decompositionPrimeCores χ) support)
            (SetLike.instMembership.mem (ErdosSzekeres.decompositionPrimeCores ψ) support)) →
      instLTNat.lt (ErdosSzekeres.PrimeCoreCountAtCard ψ m)
          (ErdosSzekeres.PrimeCoreCountAtCard χ m) →
        instLTNat.lt (ErdosSzekeres.StratifiedPrimeCoreRank ψ)
          (ErdosSzekeres.StratifiedPrimeCoreRank χ)

doc:
A single mutation supplies one changed triple and coloring agreement on
every support that omits at least one of its vertices.

type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ ψ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n},
  ErdosSzekeres.SingleTripleMutation χ ψ →
    Exists fun changed =>
      And (Ne (χ changed) (ψ changed))
        (∀ (support : Finset (Fin n)),
          Not (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset changed.support support) → χ.AgreeOnTriples ψ support)

doc:
A deep-below split is unchanged when the two colorings agree on its
support.

    χ.AgreeOnTriples ψ (Finset.instUnion.union lower upper) →
      ErdosSzekeres.HasDeepBelowSplit ψ lower upper

doc:
On a nonempty ground set, the stratified rank vanishes exactly at the
recursively decomposable colorings.
name: ErdosSzekeres.stratifiedPrimeCoreRank_eq_zero_iff
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n},
  instLTNat.lt 0 n →
    Iff (Eq (ErdosSzekeres.StratifiedPrimeCoreRank χ) 0) (ErdosSzekeres.IsDecomposable χ)

doc:
A mutation cannot change whether a support is decomposition-prime unless
that support contains all three changed vertices.

type_pp:

      (∀ (u : ErdosSzekeres.OrderedTriple n), Ne u changed → Eq (χ u) (ψ u)) →
    Not (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset changed.support support) →
      Iff (ErdosSzekeres.IsDecompositionPrimeOn χ support)
        (ErdosSzekeres.IsDecompositionPrimeOn ψ support)

inside that support.

destroyed and newly created prime cores.

type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ ψ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n},

              (ErdosSzekeres.IsDecompositionPrimeOn ψ support))

doc:
At every cardinality stratum, a single mutation can change prime-core
membership only on supports containing all three changed vertices.
name: ErdosSzekeres.SingleTripleMutation.primeCoreStratum_symmDiff_subset
type_pp:
∀ {n m : Nat} {χ ψ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {changed : ErdosSzekeres.OrderedTriple n},
  And (Ne (χ changed) (ψ changed))
      (∀ (u : ErdosSzekeres.OrderedTriple n), Ne u changed → Eq (χ u) (ψ u)) →
    Finset.instHasSubset.Subset
      (symmDiff
        (Finset.filter (fun support => Eq support.card m) (ErdosSzekeres.decompositionPrimeCores χ))
        (Finset.filter (fun support => Eq support.card m)
          (ErdosSzekeres.decompositionPrimeCores ψ)))
      (Finset.filter
        (fun support =>
          And (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset changed.support support) (Eq support.card m))
        Finset.univ.powerset)

doc:
The symmetric difference of the prime-core families is contained in the
family of supports carrying all three changed vertices.

type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ ψ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {changed : ErdosSzekeres.OrderedTriple n},
  And (Ne (χ changed) (ψ changed))
      (∀ (u : ErdosSzekeres.OrderedTriple n), Ne u changed → Eq (χ u) (ψ u)) →
    Finset.instHasSubset.Subset
      (symmDiff (ErdosSzekeres.decompositionPrimeCores χ) (ErdosSzekeres.decompositionPrimeCores ψ))
      (Finset.filter (fun support => Finset.instHasSubset.Subset changed.support support)
        Finset.univ.powerset)

The symmetric difference of the endpoint prime-core families is supported
on sets containing one of at most three changed triples.

            Finset.univ.powerset))

doc:
The full 32-vertex singleton-lower reservoir contains three pairwise
disjoint upper four-caps. Absence of a parent five-cap forces every selected

vertices after the selection, unlike the refuted constant-size cup core.

type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {q : Fin n} {upper : Finset (Fin n)},
  ErdosSzekeres.IsDecomposableOn χ upper →
    ErdosSzekeres.HasDeepBelowSplit χ (Finset.instSingleton.singleton q) upper →
      Eq upper.card 32 →
        Not
            (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCapSet χ
              (Finset.instUnion.union (Finset.instSingleton.singleton q) upper) 5) →
          Not
              (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCupSet χ
                (Finset.instUnion.union (Finset.instSingleton.singleton q) upper) 7) →
            Not
                (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet χ
                  (Finset.instUnion.union (Finset.instSingleton.singleton q) upper) 8) →
              Exists fun cap1 =>
                Exists fun cap2 =>
                  Exists fun cap3 =>
                    And (SetLike.instMembership.mem (ErdosSzekeres.capWitnesses χ upper 4) cap1)
                      (And (SetLike.instMembership.mem (ErdosSzekeres.capWitnesses χ upper 4) cap2)
                        (And
                          (SetLike.instMembership.mem (ErdosSzekeres.capWitnesses χ upper 4) cap3)
                          (And (Disjoint cap1 cap2)
                            (And (Disjoint cap1 cap3)
                              (And (Disjoint cap2 cap3)
                                (And (Not (ErdosSzekeres.HasDeepBelowSplit.IsSweepEndpoint cap1 q))
                                  (And
                                    (Not (ErdosSzekeres.HasDeepBelowSplit.IsSweepEndpoint cap2 q))
                                    (Not
                                      (ErdosSzekeres.HasDeepBelowSplit.IsSweepEndpoint cap3
                                        q)))))))))

consecutive right extensions.
name: ErdosSzekeres.compatibleRightExtensionLinks_connectorBlockLaw
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} (ψ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring (instHAdd.hAdd n 2)),
  ErdosSzekeres.OneChangeOn ψ Finset.univ →
    Exists fun πLambda =>
      Exists fun πMu =>
        And (ψ.penultimateRightExtensionLink.RepresentedBy πLambda)
          (And (ψ.finalRightExtensionLinkOnInitial.RepresentedBy πMu)
            (And
              (∀ (i j : Fin n),
                Eq (ψ.rightExtensionConnectorColor i) ErdosSzekeres.Turn.left →
                  Eq (ψ.rightExtensionConnectorColor j) ErdosSzekeres.Turn.right →
                    And
                      (instLTFin.lt (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe πLambda i)
                        (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe πLambda j))
                      (instLTFin.lt (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe πMu i)
                        (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe πMu j)))
              (And
                (∀ (c : ErdosSzekeres.Turn),
                  ErdosSzekeres.ConnectorFiberIsInterval πLambda ψ.rightExtensionConnectorColor c)
                (And
                  (∀ (c : ErdosSzekeres.Turn),
                    ErdosSzekeres.ConnectorFiberIsInterval πMu ψ.rightExtensionConnectorColor c)
                  (And
                    (∀ {i j : Fin n} (hij : instLTFin.lt i j),
                      ErdosSzekeres.TurnSequenceAllowed
                        (ψ.penultimateRightExtensionLink { i := i, j := j, hij := hij })
                        (ψ.finalRightExtensionLinkOnInitial { i := i, j := j, hij := hij })
                        (ψ.rightExtensionConnectorColor i) (ψ.rightExtensionConnectorColor j))
                    (ErdosSzekeres.BlockwiseOneDirectionalTransition ψ.penultimateRightExtensionLink
                      ψ.finalRightExtensionLinkOnInitial ψ.rightExtensionConnectorColor))))))

doc:
Source-side internal-carrier witnesses preserve proper splits on the same
bounded family of supports.  This is only a cardinality-restricted consequence,
not the existing unfiltered `HasPersistentPrimeSplitShield`.
name: ErdosSzekeres.HasCarrierInternalSourceSplitsAboveAt.to_endpointSplits
type_pp:
∀ {m n : Nat} {χ ψ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {changed : ErdosSzekeres.OrderedTriple n},
  ErdosSzekeres.HasCarrierInternalSourceSplitsAboveAt m χ changed →
    And (Ne (χ changed) (ψ changed))
        (∀ (u : ErdosSzekeres.OrderedTriple n), Ne u changed → Eq (χ u) (ψ u)) →
      ∀ (support : Finset (Fin n)),
        instLENat.le m support.card →
          Finset.instHasSubset.Subset changed.support support →
            ErdosSzekeres.HasProperDeepBelowSplitOn χ support →
              ErdosSzekeres.HasProperDeepBelowSplitOn ψ support

doc:
The source-only witness family needed to use carrier-internal persistence
on supports at or above one cardinality stratum.

This definition is independent of the endpoint coloring, but it remains a
producer obligation: it strengthens mere source split existence by requiring
an internal-carrier witness for every relevant support.  The cardinality bound
is essential: on the support consisting of the changed triple itself, no proper
split can put all three changed vertices on one side.
name: ErdosSzekeres.HasCarrierInternalSourceSplitsAboveAt
type_pp: {n : Nat} → Nat → ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n → ErdosSzekeres.OrderedTriple n → Prop

doc:
A deep-below split persists across a single-triple mutation when all three
vertices of the changed triple lie on one side of the split.
name: ErdosSzekeres.HasDeepBelowSplit.persists_of_singleMutation_internal
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ ψ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {changed : ErdosSzekeres.OrderedTriple n}
  {lower upper : Finset (Fin n)},
  ErdosSzekeres.HasDeepBelowSplit χ lower upper →
    And (Ne (χ changed) (ψ changed))
        (∀ (u : ErdosSzekeres.OrderedTriple n), Ne u changed → Eq (χ u) (ψ u)) →
      Or (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset changed.support lower)
          (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset changed.support upper) →
        ErdosSzekeres.HasDeepBelowSplit ψ lower upper

doc:
Four nonempty corners of two deep-below splits supply two vertices in
each side of the first split and hence a strong four-set.
name: ErdosSzekeres.crossingDeepSplits_containStrongFour
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {lower₁ upper₁ lower₂ upper₂ : Finset (Fin n)},
  ErdosSzekeres.HasDeepBelowSplit χ lower₁ upper₁ →
    ErdosSzekeres.HasDeepBelowSplit χ lower₂ upper₂ →
      ∀ {xLL xLU xUL xUU : Fin n},
        SetLike.instMembership.mem lower₁ xLL →
          SetLike.instMembership.mem lower₂ xLL →
            SetLike.instMembership.mem lower₁ xLU →
              SetLike.instMembership.mem upper₂ xLU →
                SetLike.instMembership.mem upper₁ xUL →
                  SetLike.instMembership.mem lower₂ xUL →
                    SetLike.instMembership.mem upper₁ xUU →
                      SetLike.instMembership.mem upper₂ xUU →
                        ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet χ
                          (Finset.instUnion.union lower₁ upper₁) 4

doc: Exact Fin8 half-pure deep-split theorem under the rank-three one-change law.
name: ErdosSzekeres.halfPureDeepSplitAtFiveFinEight_of_oneChange
type_pp:
∀ (χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring 8),
  ErdosSzekeres.OneChangeOn χ Finset.univ →
    Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet χ Finset.univ 5) →
      Exists fun lower =>
        Exists fun upper =>
          And (ErdosSzekeres.HasDeepBelowSplit χ lower upper)
            (Or
              (And upper.Nonempty
                (And (instLENat.le 8 (instHMul.hMul 2 lower.card))
                  (∀ (polygon : Finset (Fin 8)),
                    Finset.instHasSubset.Subset polygon lower →
                      Eq polygon.card (instHSub.hSub 5 1) →
                        ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet χ polygon →
                          ErdosSzekeres.IsCupSet χ polygon)))
              (And lower.Nonempty
                (And (instLENat.le 8 (instHMul.hMul 2 upper.card))
                  (∀ (polygon : Finset (Fin 8)),
                    Finset.instHasSubset.Subset polygon upper →
                      Eq polygon.card (instHSub.hSub 5 1) →
                        ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet χ polygon →
                          ErdosSzekeres.IsCapSet χ polygon))))

doc: Exact k=6,n=10 singleton-fan theorem under the rank-three one-change law.
name: ErdosSzekeres.halfPureSingletonFanAtSixFinTen_of_oneChange
type_pp:
∀ (χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring 10),
  ErdosSzekeres.OneChangeOn χ Finset.univ →
    Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet χ Finset.univ 6) →
      Exists fun side =>
        Exists fun pivot =>
          And (Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem side pivot))
            (And (instLENat.le 10 (instHMul.hMul 2 side.card))
              (Or
                (And (ErdosSzekeres.HasDeepBelowSplit χ side (Finset.instSingleton.singleton pivot))
                  (∀ (polygon : Finset (Fin 10)),
                    Finset.instHasSubset.Subset polygon side →
                      Eq polygon.card 5 →
                        ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet χ polygon →
                          ErdosSzekeres.IsCupSet χ polygon))
                (And (ErdosSzekeres.HasDeepBelowSplit χ (Finset.instSingleton.singleton pivot) side)
                  (∀ (polygon : Finset (Fin 10)),
                    Finset.instHasSubset.Subset polygon side →
                      Eq polygon.card 5 →
                        ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet χ polygon →
                          ErdosSzekeres.IsCapSet χ polygon))))

doc:

high multiplicity, or their distinct complements form the unique-pair
incidence design at the extremal size.

type_pp:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] (support : Finset α) (anchor : Fin 8 → Finset α),
  Eq support.card 7 →
    (∀ (i : Fin 8), Finset.instHasSubset.Subset (anchor i) support) →
      (∀ (i : Fin 8), Eq (anchor i).card 4) →
        (∀ (i j : Fin 8),
            Ne (anchor i) (anchor j) →
              instLENat.le (Finset.instInter.inter (anchor i) (anchor j)).card 2) →
          have blocks := Finset.image anchor Finset.univ;
          And (instLENat.le blocks.card 7)
            (And
              (Eq blocks.card 7 →
                ∀ (pair : Finset α),
                  Finset.instHasSubset.Subset pair support →
                    Eq pair.card 2 →
                      ExistsUnique fun block =>
                        And (SetLike.instMembership.mem blocks block)
                          (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset pair (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff support block)))
              (instLENat.le blocks.card 6 →
                Or
                  (Exists fun block =>
                    And (SetLike.instMembership.mem blocks block)
                      (instLENat.le 3
                        (Finset.filter (fun i => Eq (anchor i) block) Finset.univ).card))
                  (Exists fun block₁ =>
                    And (SetLike.instMembership.mem blocks block₁)
                      (Exists fun block₂ =>
                        And (SetLike.instMembership.mem blocks block₂)
                          (And (Ne block₁ block₂)

name: ErdosSzekeres.fin15_singleExchange_candidate_anchor_trichotomy
type_pp:
∀ (chi : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring 15) {support : Finset (Fin 15)} {q r c : Fin 15},
  ErdosSzekeres.IsMaximumPredecessorFreeSupport chi 6 support →
    Eq support.card 7 →
      SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support) q →
        SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support) r →
          Ne q r →
            SetLike.instMembership.mem support c →
              Or
                (Exists fun residue =>
                  And (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset residue (support.erase c))
                    (And (Eq residue.card 3)
                      (ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet chi
                        (Finset.instInsert.insert q (Finset.instInsert.insert r residue)))))
                (Or
                  (Exists fun anchor =>
                    And (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset anchor (support.erase c))
                      (And (Eq anchor.card 4)
                        (ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet chi (Finset.instInsert.insert q anchor))))
                  (Exists fun anchor =>
                    And (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset anchor (support.erase c))
                      (And (Eq anchor.card 4)
                        (ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet chi
                          (Finset.instInsert.insert r anchor)))))

doc:
A complete eight-anchor system has either a repeated blocker retaining the
global Fano/multiplicity classification, or a distinct one-for-one exchange.
This is the exact two-branch package consumed by the raw contradiction files.
name: ErdosSzekeres.fin15ExteriorSystem_raw_branch_package
type_pp:
∀ (chi : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring 15) {support : Finset (Fin 15)}
  {anchor : Fin 15 → Finset (Fin 15)},
  ErdosSzekeres.Fin15ExteriorSystem chi support anchor →
    Or
      (Exists fun index =>
        And (ErdosSzekeres.Fin15ExteriorFanoOrMultiplicity support anchor index)
          (And
            (∀ (u : Fin 15),
              SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support) u →
                ∀ (v : Fin 15),
                  SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support) v →
                    Ne (anchor u) (anchor v) →
                      instLENat.le (Finset.instInter.inter (anchor u) (anchor v)).card 2)
            (Exists fun i =>
              Exists fun j =>
                And (Ne i j)
                  (Eq (anchor (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe index i).val)
                    (anchor (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe index j).val)))))
      (Exists fun q =>
        And (SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support) q)
          (Exists fun r =>
            And (SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support) r)
              (And (Ne q r)
                (And (Eq (Finset.instInter.inter (anchor q) (anchor r)).card 3)
                  (And (Eq (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff (anchor q) (anchor r)).card 1)
                    (Eq (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff (anchor r) (anchor q)).card 1))))))

doc:
Any three four-point blocks in a seven-point support have a two-point
transversal: one point hits the first two blocks and a distinct point hits the
third.
name: ErdosSzekeres.exists_twoPoint_transversal_three_fourBlocks
type_pp:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] (support first second third : Finset α),
  Eq support.card 7 →
    Finset.instHasSubset.Subset first support →
      Finset.instHasSubset.Subset second support →
        Finset.instHasSubset.Subset third support →
          Eq first.card 4 →
            Eq second.card 4 →
              Eq third.card 4 →
                Exists fun x =>
                  And (SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instInter.inter first second) x)
                    (Exists fun y => And (SetLike.instMembership.mem third y) (Ne x y))

doc:
The discriminating Fano consumer for a transversal-forced witness.  A
multi-owner strong five remains as an explicit residue; a one-owner witness
is a genuinely alternative anchor and saturates to either an existing block
or an exact single exchange.  No well-founded decrease is asserted.
name: ErdosSzekeres.fano_transversalWitness_multiOwner_or_reselector
type_pp:
∀ (chi : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring 15) {support : Finset (Fin 15)}
  (blocks : Finset (Finset (Fin 15))) (first second third : Finset (Fin 15)) (q r s x y : Fin 15),
  Eq support.card 7 →
    (∀ (block : Finset (Fin 15)),
        SetLike.instMembership.mem blocks block → Finset.instHasSubset.Subset block support) →
      (∀ (block : Finset (Fin 15)), SetLike.instMembership.mem blocks block → Eq block.card 4) →
        (∀ (pair : Finset (Fin 15)),
            Finset.instHasSubset.Subset pair support →
              Eq pair.card 2 →
                ExistsUnique fun block =>
                  And (SetLike.instMembership.mem blocks block)
                    (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset pair (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff support block))) →
          SetLike.instMembership.mem blocks first →
            SetLike.instMembership.mem blocks second →
              SetLike.instMembership.mem blocks third →
                Not (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset first ((support.erase x).erase y)) →
                  Not (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset second ((support.erase x).erase y)) →
                    Not (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset third ((support.erase x).erase y)) →
                      ErdosSzekeres.Fin15ThreeExteriorDoubleEraseWitness chi support q r s x y →
                        Or
                          (Or
                            (Exists fun residue =>
                              And (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset residue ((support.erase x).erase y))
                                (And (Eq residue.card 2)
                                  (ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet chi
                                    (Finset.instInsert.insert q
                                      (Finset.instInsert.insert r
                                        (Finset.instInsert.insert s residue))))))
                            (Or
                              (Exists fun residue =>
                                And
                                  (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset residue ((support.erase x).erase y))
                                  (And (Eq residue.card 3)
                                    (ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet chi
                                      (Finset.instInsert.insert q
                                        (Finset.instInsert.insert r residue)))))
                              (Or
                                (Exists fun residue =>
                                  And
                                    (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset residue
                                      ((support.erase x).erase y))
                                    (And (Eq residue.card 3)
                                      (ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet chi
                                        (Finset.instInsert.insert q
                                          (Finset.instInsert.insert s residue)))))
                                (Exists fun residue =>
                                  And
                                    (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset residue
                                      ((support.erase x).erase y))
                                    (And (Eq residue.card 3)
                                      (ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet chi
                                        (Finset.instInsert.insert r
                                          (Finset.instInsert.insert s residue))))))))
                          (Or
                            (Exists fun alternative =>
                              And
                                (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset alternative
                                  ((support.erase x).erase y))
                                (And (Eq alternative.card 4)
                                  (And
                                    (ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet chi
                                      (Finset.instInsert.insert q alternative))
                                    (And (Ne alternative first)
                                      (Or (SetLike.instMembership.mem blocks alternative)
                                        (Exists fun block =>
                                          And (SetLike.instMembership.mem blocks block)
                                            (And
                                              (Eq (Finset.instInter.inter alternative block).card 3)
                                              (And
                                                (Eq (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff alternative block).card
                                                  1)
                                                (Eq (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff block alternative).card
                                                  1)))))))))
                            (Or
                              (Exists fun alternative =>
                                And
                                  (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset alternative
                                    ((support.erase x).erase y))
                                  (And (Eq alternative.card 4)
                                    (And
                                      (ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet chi
                                        (Finset.instInsert.insert r alternative))
                                      (And (Ne alternative second)
                                        (Or (SetLike.instMembership.mem blocks alternative)
                                          (Exists fun block =>
                                            And (SetLike.instMembership.mem blocks block)
                                              (And
                                                (Eq (Finset.instInter.inter alternative block).card
                                                  3)
                                                (And
                                                  (Eq
                                                    (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff alternative block).card
                                                    1)
                                                  (Eq
                                                    (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff block alternative).card
                                                    1)))))))))
                              (Exists fun alternative =>
                                And
                                  (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset alternative
                                    ((support.erase x).erase y))
                                  (And (Eq alternative.card 4)
                                    (And
                                      (ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet chi
                                        (Finset.instInsert.insert s alternative))
                                      (And (Ne alternative third)
                                        (Or (SetLike.instMembership.mem blocks alternative)
                                          (Exists fun block =>
                                            And (SetLike.instMembership.mem blocks block)
                                              (And
                                                (Eq (Finset.instInter.inter alternative block).card
                                                  3)
                                                (And
                                                  (Eq
                                                    (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff alternative block).card
                                                    1)
                                                  (Eq
                                                    (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff block alternative).card
                                                    1)))))))))))

doc:
Closed control combining the three pair defects with the premise-inert
trichotomy grid over support points omitted by the shared block.
name: ErdosSzekeres.fin15_threeFiber_pairDefects_and_trichotomyGrid
type_pp:
∀ (chi : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring 15),
  ErdosSzekeres.OneChangeOn chi Finset.univ →
    Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet chi Finset.univ 6) →
      ∀ {support : Finset (Fin 15)} {anchor : Fin 15 → Finset (Fin 15)},
        ErdosSzekeres.IsMaximumPredecessorFreeSupport chi 6 support →
          Eq support.card 7 →
            (∀ (vertex : Fin 15),
                SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support) vertex →
                  And (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset (anchor vertex) support)
                    (And (Eq (anchor vertex).card 4)
                      (ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet chi
                        (Finset.instInsert.insert vertex (anchor vertex))))) →
              ∀
                (index :
                  Equiv (Fin 8)
                    (Subtype fun vertex =>
                      SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support)
                        vertex))
                (block : Finset (Fin 15)),
                instLENat.le 3
                    (Finset.filter
                        (fun i => Eq (anchor (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe index i).val) block)
                        Finset.univ).card →
                  Exists fun q =>
                    And (SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support) q)
                      (Exists fun r =>
                        And
                          (SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support)
                            r)
                          (Exists fun s =>
                            And
                              (SetLike.instMembership.mem
                                (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support) s)
                              (And (Ne q r)
                                (And (Ne q s)
                                  (And (Ne r s)
                                    (And (Eq (anchor q) block)
                                      (And (Eq (anchor r) block)
                                        (And (Eq (anchor s) block)
                                          (And (ErdosSzekeres.Fin15SharedPairDefect chi block q r)
                                            (And (ErdosSzekeres.Fin15SharedPairDefect chi block q s)
                                              (And
                                                (ErdosSzekeres.Fin15SharedPairDefect chi block r s)
                                                (And
                                                  (Eq (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff support block).card 3)
                                                  (∀ (c : Fin 15),
                                                    SetLike.instMembership.mem
                                                        (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff support block) c →
                                                      And
                                                        (ErdosSzekeres.Fin15ExchangeWitnessTrichotomy
                                                          chi support q r c)
                                                        (And
                                                          (ErdosSzekeres.Fin15ExchangeWitnessTrichotomy
                                                            chi support q s c)
                                                          (ErdosSzekeres.Fin15ExchangeWitnessTrichotomy
                                                            chi support r s c)))))))))))))))

doc:
The first non-premise-inert maximum-support coupling for a shared
three-owner block: erase two distinct block vertices, force a strong five in
the resulting eight-set, classify its one/two/three exterior-owner pattern,
and certify that at most two vertices of the original block survive.
name: ErdosSzekeres.fin15_threeExterior_doubleBaseErase_forcedWitness
type_pp:
∀ (chi : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring 15) {support base : Finset (Fin 15)} {q r s c d : Fin 15},
  ErdosSzekeres.IsMaximumPredecessorFreeSupport chi 6 support →
    Eq support.card 7 →
      Finset.instHasSubset.Subset base support →
        Eq base.card 4 →
          SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support) q →
            SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support) r →
              SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support) s →
                Ne q r →
                  Ne q s →
                    Ne r s →
                      SetLike.instMembership.mem base c →
                        SetLike.instMembership.mem base d →
                          Ne c d →
                            Exists fun polygon =>
                              And
                                (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset polygon
                                  (Finset.instInsert.insert q
                                    (Finset.instInsert.insert r
                                      (Finset.instInsert.insert s ((support.erase c).erase d)))))
                                (And (Eq polygon.card 5)
                                  (And (ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet chi polygon)
                                    (And
                                      (ErdosSzekeres.Fin15ThreeExteriorWitnessPattern polygon q r s)
                                      (instLENat.le (Finset.instInter.inter polygon base).card 2))))
