doc:
The non-premise-inert residue attached directly to a classified
multiplicity-three block: for every ordered pair of distinct erased block
vertices, maximality forces a seven-way classified witness meeting the
original block in at most two vertices.
name: ErdosSzekeres.fin15_threeFiber_doubleBaseErase_forcedWitness
type_pp:
∀ (chi : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring 15),
  ErdosSzekeres.OneChangeOn chi Finset.univ →
    Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet chi Finset.univ 6) →
      ∀ {support : Finset (Fin 15)} {anchor : Fin 15 → Finset (Fin 15)},
        ErdosSzekeres.IsMaximumPredecessorFreeSupport chi 6 support →
          Eq support.card 7 →
            (∀ (vertex : Fin 15),
                SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support) vertex →
                  And (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset (anchor vertex) support)
                    (And (Eq (anchor vertex).card 4)
                      (ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet chi
                        (Finset.instInsert.insert vertex (anchor vertex))))) →
              ∀
                (index :
                  Equiv (Fin 8)
                    (Subtype fun vertex =>
                      SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support)
                        vertex))
                (block : Finset (Fin 15)),
                instLENat.le 3
                    (Finset.filter
                        (fun i => Eq (anchor (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe index i).val) block)
                        Finset.univ).card →
                  Exists fun q =>
                    And (SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support) q)
                      (Exists fun r =>
                        And
                          (SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support)
                            r)
                          (Exists fun s =>
                            And
                              (SetLike.instMembership.mem
                                (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support) s)
                              (And (Ne q r)
                                (And (Ne q s)
                                  (And (Ne r s)
                                    (And (Eq (anchor q) block)
                                      (And (Eq (anchor r) block)
                                        (And (Eq (anchor s) block)
                                          (And (ErdosSzekeres.Fin15SharedPairDefect chi block q r)
                                            (And (ErdosSzekeres.Fin15SharedPairDefect chi block q s)
                                              (And
                                                (ErdosSzekeres.Fin15SharedPairDefect chi block r s)
                                                (∀ (c : Fin 15),
                                                  SetLike.instMembership.mem block c →
                                                    ∀ (d : Fin 15),
                                                      SetLike.instMembership.mem block d →
                                                        Ne c d →
                                                          Exists fun polygon =>
                                                            And
                                                              (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset polygon
                                                                (Finset.instInsert.insert q
                                                                  (Finset.instInsert.insert r
                                                                    (Finset.instInsert.insert s
                                                                      ((support.erase c).erase
                                                                        d)))))
                                                              (And (Eq polygon.card 5)
                                                                (And
                                                                  (ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet
                                                                    chi polygon)
                                                                  (And
                                                                    (ErdosSzekeres.Fin15ThreeExteriorWitnessPattern
                                                                      polygon q r s)
                                                                    (And
                                                                      (ErdosSzekeres.Fin15ThreeExteriorDoubleEraseWitness
                                                                        chi support q r s c d)
                                                                      (instLENat.le
                                                                        (Finset.instInter.inter
                                                                            polygon block).card
                                                                        2)))))))))))))))))

doc:
Uniform three-anchor transversal coupling.  The chosen two-point deletion
kills all three supplied four-blocks, and maximality forces an exactly
classified strong-five witness in the resulting eight-set.
name: ErdosSzekeres.fin15_threeAnchors_transversal_forcedWitness
type_pp:
∀ (chi : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring 15) {support first second third : Finset (Fin 15)}
  {q r s : Fin 15},
  ErdosSzekeres.IsMaximumPredecessorFreeSupport chi 6 support →
    Eq support.card 7 →
      Finset.instHasSubset.Subset first support →
        Finset.instHasSubset.Subset second support →
          Finset.instHasSubset.Subset third support →
            Eq first.card 4 →
              Eq second.card 4 →
                Eq third.card 4 →
                  SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support) q →
                    SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support) r →
                      SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support) s →
                        Ne q r →
                          Ne q s →
                            Ne r s →
                              Exists fun x =>
                                And
                                  (SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instInter.inter first second)
                                    x)
                                  (Exists fun y =>
                                    And (SetLike.instMembership.mem third y)
                                      (And (Ne x y)
                                        (And
                                          (Not
                                            (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset first
                                              ((support.erase x).erase y)))
                                          (And
                                            (Not
                                              (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset second
                                                ((support.erase x).erase y)))
                                            (And
                                              (Not
                                                (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset third
                                                  ((support.erase x).erase y)))
                                              (Exists fun polygon =>
                                                And
                                                  (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset polygon
                                                    (Finset.instInsert.insert q
                                                      (Finset.instInsert.insert r
                                                        (Finset.instInsert.insert s
                                                          ((support.erase x).erase y)))))
                                                  (And (Eq polygon.card 5)
                                                    (And
                                                      (ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet chi polygon)
                                                      (ErdosSzekeres.Fin15ThreeExteriorDoubleEraseWitness
                                                        chi support q r s x y)))))))))

doc:
Three exterior owners of one blocker yield simultaneous pair defects.  No
parity contradiction follows from the current API: maximal-support data using
the other three support vertices is the missing global input.
name: ErdosSzekeres.fin15_threeSharedExtensions_pairDefects
type_pp:
∀ (chi : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring 15),
  ErdosSzekeres.OneChangeOn chi Finset.univ →
    Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet chi Finset.univ 6) →
      ∀ {support base : Finset (Fin 15)} {q r s : Fin 15},
        Finset.instHasSubset.Subset base support →
          Eq base.card 4 →
            SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support) q →
              SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support) r →
                SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support) s →
                  Ne q r →
                    Ne q s →
                      Ne r s →
                        ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet chi (Finset.instInsert.insert q base) →
                          ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet chi (Finset.instInsert.insert r base) →
                            ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet chi (Finset.instInsert.insert s base) →
                              And (ErdosSzekeres.Fin15SharedPairDefect chi base q r)
                                (And (ErdosSzekeres.Fin15SharedPairDefect chi base q s)
                                  (ErdosSzekeres.Fin15SharedPairDefect chi base r s))

doc:
Deleting two distinct support vertices and adjoining three distinct
exterior vertices preserves cardinality eight.
name: ErdosSzekeres.fin15_threeExterior_doubleErase_candidate_card
type_pp:
∀ {support : Finset (Fin 15)} {q r s c d : Fin 15},
  Eq support.card 7 →
    SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support) q →
      SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support) r →

            Ne q s →

doc:
Closed control: deleting a point outside `base` gives three formally
forced trichotomies for three exterior pairs.  This is premise-inert when
`base` is already a strong owner anchor, because `base ⊆ support.erase c`.

type_pp:

  ErdosSzekeres.IsMaximumPredecessorFreeSupport chi 6 support →
    Eq support.card 7 →
      Finset.instHasSubset.Subset base support →
        Eq base.card 4 →
          SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support) q →
            SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support) r →
              SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support) s →
                Ne q r →
                  Ne q s →
                    Ne r s →
                      And (Eq (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff support base).card 3)
                        (∀ (c : Fin 15),

                            And (ErdosSzekeres.Fin15ExchangeWitnessTrichotomy chi support q r c)

                                (ErdosSzekeres.Fin15ExchangeWitnessTrichotomy chi support r s c)))

doc:
Exact Fano saturation transition for a four-point candidate: it is an
existing block, or it has a distinct three-overlap with an existing block.

type_pp:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] (support : Finset α) (blocks : Finset (Finset α))

doc:
The exact shared-anchor hypotheses force a two-base single-end defect and
also supply a third exterior strong extension.  This is the narrow global
obstruction left before the frozen raw `False` endpoint.
name: ErdosSzekeres.fin15ExteriorSystem_sharedAnchor_third_defect
type_pp:
∀ (chi : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring 15),
  ErdosSzekeres.OneChangeOn chi Finset.univ →
    Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet chi Finset.univ 6) →
      ∀ {support : Finset (Fin 15)} {anchor : Fin 15 → Finset (Fin 15)},
        ErdosSzekeres.IsMaximumPredecessorFreeSupport chi 6 support →
          Eq support.card 7 →
            Eq (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support).card 8 →
              (∀ (vertex : Fin 15),
                  SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support) vertex →
                    And (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset (anchor vertex) support)
                      (And (Eq (anchor vertex).card 4)
                        (ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet chi
                          (Finset.instInsert.insert vertex (anchor vertex))))) →
                ∀ {q r : Fin 15},
                  SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support) q →
                    SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support) r →
                      Ne q r →
                        Eq (anchor q) (anchor r) →
                          Exists fun s =>
                            And
                              (SetLike.instMembership.mem
                                (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support) s)
                              (And (Ne s q)
                                (And (Ne s r)
                                  (And (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset (anchor s) support)
                                    (And (Eq (anchor s).card 4)
                                      (And
                                        (ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet chi
                                          (Finset.instInsert.insert s (anchor s)))
                                        (Exists fun i =>
                                          Exists fun j =>
                                            Exists fun k =>
                                              Exists fun l =>
                                                Exists fun hij =>
                                                  Exists fun hjk =>
                                                    Exists fun hkl =>
                                                      And
                                                        (SetLike.instMembership.mem
                                                          (Finset.instInsert.insert q
                                                            (Finset.instInsert.insert r (anchor q)))
                                                          i)
                                                        (And
                                                          (SetLike.instMembership.mem
                                                            (Finset.instInsert.insert q
                                                              (Finset.instInsert.insert r
                                                                (anchor q)))
                                                            j)
                                                          (And
                                                            (SetLike.instMembership.mem
                                                              (Finset.instInsert.insert q
                                                                (Finset.instInsert.insert r
                                                                  (anchor q)))
                                                              k)
                                                            (And
                                                              (SetLike.instMembership.mem
                                                                (Finset.instInsert.insert q
                                                                  (Finset.instInsert.insert r
                                                                    (anchor q)))
                                                                l)
                                                              (And
                                                                (Or (Eq q i)
                                                                  (Or (Eq q j)
                                                                    (Or (Eq q k) (Eq q l))))
                                                                (And
                                                                  (Or (Eq r i)
                                                                    (Or (Eq r j)
                                                                      (Or (Eq r k) (Eq r l))))
                                                                  (And
                                                                    (Eq
                                                                      (Finset.instInter.inter
                                                                          (Finset.instInsert.insert
                                                                            i
                                                                            (Finset.instInsert.insert
                                                                              j
                                                                              (Finset.instInsert.insert
                                                                                k
                                                                                (Finset.instSingleton.singleton
                                                                                  l))))
                                                                          (anchor q)).card
                                                                      2)
                                                                    (Or
                                                                      (And
                                                                        (Eq
                                                                          (chi
                                                                            { i := i, j := j,
                                                                              k := k, hij := hij,
                                                                              hjk := hjk })
                                                                          (chi
                                                                            { i := i, j := j,
                                                                              k := l, hij := hij,
                                                                              hjk := ⋯ }))
                                                                        (Ne
                                                                          (chi
                                                                            { i := i, j := k,
                                                                              k := l, hij := ⋯,
                                                                              hjk := hkl })
                                                                          (chi
                                                                            { i := j, j := k,
                                                                              k := l, hij := hjk,
                                                                              hjk := hkl })))
                                                                      (And
                                                                        (Ne
                                                                          (chi
                                                                            { i := i, j := j,
                                                                              k := k, hij := hij,
                                                                              hjk := hjk })
                                                                          (chi
                                                                            { i := i, j := j,
                                                                              k := l, hij := hij,
                                                                              hjk := ⋯ }))
                                                                        (Eq
                                                                          (chi
                                                                            { i := i, j := k,
                                                                              k := l, hij := ⋯,
                                                                              hjk := hkl })
                                                                          (chi
                                                                            { i := j, j := k,
                                                                              k := l, hij := hjk,
                                                                              hjk :=
                                                                                hkl }))))))))))))))))

doc:
A multiplicity-three fiber in the global classification reduces exactly
to three distinct exterior owners of one blocker and their three simultaneous
pair defects.
name: ErdosSzekeres.fin15_threeFiber_pairDefects
type_pp:
∀ (chi : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring 15),
  ErdosSzekeres.OneChangeOn chi Finset.univ →
    Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet chi Finset.univ 6) →
      ∀ {support : Finset (Fin 15)} {anchor : Fin 15 → Finset (Fin 15)},
        (∀ (vertex : Fin 15),
            SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support) vertex →
              And (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset (anchor vertex) support)
                (And (Eq (anchor vertex).card 4)
                  (ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet chi
                    (Finset.instInsert.insert vertex (anchor vertex))))) →
          ∀
            (index :
              Equiv (Fin 8)
                (Subtype fun vertex =>
                  SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support) vertex))
            (block : Finset (Fin 15)),
            instLENat.le 3
                (Finset.filter (fun i => Eq (anchor (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe index i).val) block)
                    Finset.univ).card →
              Exists fun q =>
                And (SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support) q)
                  (Exists fun r =>
                    And (SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support) r)
                      (Exists fun s =>
                        And
                          (SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support)
                            s)
                          (And (Ne q r)
                            (And (Ne q s)
                              (And (Ne r s)
                                (And (Eq (anchor q) block)
                                  (And (Eq (anchor r) block)
                                    (And (Eq (anchor s) block)
                                      (And (ErdosSzekeres.Fin15SharedPairDefect chi block q r)
                                        (And (ErdosSzekeres.Fin15SharedPairDefect chi block q s)
                                          (ErdosSzekeres.Fin15SharedPairDefect chi block r
                                            s)))))))))))

doc:
The genuinely atomic left branch: after explicitly excluding every
distinct three-overlap exchange, all eight indexed anchors retain the full
Fano/multiplicity alternative.  This theorem is global combinatorial data, not
the still-open raw contradiction.
name: ErdosSzekeres.fin15ExteriorSystem_sharedAnchor_atomic_classification
type_pp:
∀ {support : Finset (Fin 15)} {anchor : Fin 15 → Finset (Fin 15)},
  Eq support.card 7 →
    Eq (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support).card 8 →
      (∀ (vertex : Fin 15),
          SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support) vertex →
            Finset.instHasSubset.Subset (anchor vertex) support) →
        (∀ (vertex : Fin 15),
            SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support) vertex →
              Eq (anchor vertex).card 4) →
          ∀ {q r : Fin 15},
            SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support) q →
              SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support) r →
                Ne q r →
                  Eq (anchor q) (anchor r) →
                    (∀ (u : Fin 15),
                        SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support) u →
                          ∀ (v : Fin 15),
                            SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support)
                                v →
                              Ne (anchor u) (anchor v) →
                                instLENat.le (Finset.instInter.inter (anchor u) (anchor v)).card
                                  2) →
                      Exists fun index =>
                        And (Eq (anchor q) (anchor r))
                          (have indexedAnchor := fun i =>
                            anchor (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe index i).val;
                          have blocks := Finset.image indexedAnchor Finset.univ;
                          Or
                            (And (Eq blocks.card 7)
                              (∀ (pair : Finset (Fin 15)),
                                Finset.instHasSubset.Subset pair support →
                                  Eq pair.card 2 →
                                    ExistsUnique fun block =>
                                      And (SetLike.instMembership.mem blocks block)
                                        (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset pair
                                          (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff support block))))
                            (And (instLENat.le blocks.card 6)
                              (Or
                                (Exists fun block =>
                                  And (SetLike.instMembership.mem blocks block)
                                    (instLENat.le 3
                                      (Finset.filter (fun i => Eq (indexedAnchor i) block)
                                          Finset.univ).card))
                                (Exists fun block₁ =>
                                  And (SetLike.instMembership.mem blocks block₁)
                                    (Exists fun block₂ =>
                                      And (SetLike.instMembership.mem blocks block₂)
                                        (And (Ne block₁ block₂)
                                          (And
                                            (instLENat.le 2
                                              (Finset.filter (fun i => Eq (indexedAnchor i) block₁)
                                                  Finset.univ).card)
                                            (instLENat.le 2
                                              (Finset.filter (fun i => Eq (indexedAnchor i) block₂)
                                                  Finset.univ).card))))))))

doc:
Saturation of the seven-block complement-pair design: a new four-block

doc:
An exact seven-way residue decomposition of any strong five contained in
a three-exterior extension of a base set.
name: ErdosSzekeres.fin15_threeExterior_exactWitness_of_polygon
type_pp:
∀ (chi : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring 15) {support : Finset (Fin 15)} {q r s c d : Fin 15}
  {polygon : Finset (Fin 15)},
  Finset.instHasSubset.Subset polygon

        (Finset.instInsert.insert r (Finset.instInsert.insert s ((support.erase c).erase d)))) →

doc:
The exact single-exchange hypotheses expose all three common-point
trichotomies while retaining a third exterior strong extension.
name: ErdosSzekeres.fin15ExteriorSystem_singleExchange_third_trichotomies
type_pp:
∀ (chi : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring 15),
  ErdosSzekeres.OneChangeOn chi Finset.univ →
    Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet chi Finset.univ 6) →
      ∀ {support : Finset (Fin 15)} {anchor : Fin 15 → Finset (Fin 15)},
        ErdosSzekeres.IsMaximumPredecessorFreeSupport chi 6 support →
          Eq support.card 7 →
            Eq (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support).card 8 →
              (∀ (vertex : Fin 15),
                  SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support) vertex →
                    And (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset (anchor vertex) support)
                      (And (Eq (anchor vertex).card 4)
                        (ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet chi
                          (Finset.instInsert.insert vertex (anchor vertex))))) →
                ∀ {q r : Fin 15},
                  SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support) q →
                    SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support) r →
                      Ne q r →
                        Eq (Finset.instInter.inter (anchor q) (anchor r)).card 3 →
                          Eq (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff (anchor q) (anchor r)).card 1 →
                            Eq (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff (anchor r) (anchor q)).card 1 →
                              Exists fun a =>
                                Exists fun b =>
                                  And (Ne a b)
                                    (And
                                      (Eq (anchor q)
                                        (Finset.instInsert.insert a
                                          (Finset.instInter.inter (anchor q) (anchor r))))
                                      (And
                                        (Eq (anchor r)
                                          (Finset.instInsert.insert b
                                            (Finset.instInter.inter (anchor q) (anchor r))))
                                        (Exists fun s =>
                                          And
                                            (SetLike.instMembership.mem
                                              (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff Finset.univ support) s)
                                            (And (Ne s q)
                                              (And (Ne s r)
                                                (And
                                                  (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset (anchor s) support)
                                                  (And (Eq (anchor s).card 4)
                                                    (And
                                                      (ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet chi
                                                        (Finset.instInsert.insert s (anchor s)))
                                                      (And
                                                        (Eq
                                                          (Finset.instInter.inter (anchor q)
                                                              (anchor r)).card
                                                          3)
                                                        (∀ (c : Fin 15),

                                                              (Finset.instInter.inter (anchor q)

                                                              c →

doc: The four multi-owner alternatives in the exact three-exterior witness.
name: ErdosSzekeres.Fin15ThreeExteriorMultiOwnerWitness

doc:
A common-anchor multi-owner conclusion can choose its two support
erasures after choosing the residue.  The resulting double-erased candidate
contains the same multi-owner strong five and erases at least one point of the
common four-base.
name: ErdosSzekeres.fin15_commonAnchor_multiOwner_adaptiveDoubleErase
type_pp:
∀ (chi : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring 15) {support base : Finset (Fin 15)} {q r s : Fin 15},
  Eq support.card 7 →
    Finset.instHasSubset.Subset base support →
      Eq base.card 4 →
        Or
            (Exists fun residue =>
              And (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset residue base)
                (And (Eq residue.card 2)
                  (ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet chi
                    (Finset.instInsert.insert q
                      (Finset.instInsert.insert r (Finset.instInsert.insert s residue))))))
            (Or
              (Exists fun residue =>
                And (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset residue base)
                  (And (Eq residue.card 3)
                    (ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet chi
                      (Finset.instInsert.insert q (Finset.instInsert.insert r residue)))))
              (Or
                (Exists fun residue =>
                  And (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset residue base)
                    (And (Eq residue.card 3)
                      (ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet chi
                        (Finset.instInsert.insert q (Finset.instInsert.insert s residue)))))
                (Exists fun residue =>
                  And (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset residue base)
                    (And (Eq residue.card 3)
                      (ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet chi
                        (Finset.instInsert.insert r (Finset.instInsert.insert s residue))))))) →
          Exists fun x =>
            And (SetLike.instMembership.mem support x)
              (Exists fun y =>
                And (SetLike.instMembership.mem support y)
                  (And (Ne x y)
                    (And (Not (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset base ((support.erase x).erase y)))
                      (ErdosSzekeres.Fin15ThreeExteriorMultiOwnerWitness chi support q r s x y))))

doc:
At the Fin15 parameter, at most seven four-blockers can have all pairwise
intersections of size at most two.

doc:

doc:
A cup-four plus two disjoint uniform-left spectators contains a strong
six-set—indeed, their union is a cup-six.

    Finset.instHasSubset.Subset spectators ambient →

doc:
The exact bounded singleton-fan conclusion on `Fin 9`.  This implication
is vacuous: its one-change and strong-five-free hypotheses contradict
`containsStrongFiveFinNine_of_oneChange`, so it supplies no fan witness in a
realizable premise state.

type_pp:
∀ (χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring 9),
  ErdosSzekeres.OneChangeOn χ Finset.univ →
    Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet χ Finset.univ 5) →
      Exists fun side =>
        Exists fun pivot =>
          And (Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem side pivot))
            (And (instLENat.le 9 (instHMul.hMul 2 side.card))
              (Or
                (And (ErdosSzekeres.HasDeepBelowSplit χ side (Finset.instSingleton.singleton pivot))
                  (∀ (polygon : Finset (Fin 9)),
                    Finset.instHasSubset.Subset polygon side →
                      Eq polygon.card 4 →
                        ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet χ polygon →
                          ErdosSzekeres.IsCupSet χ polygon))
                (And (ErdosSzekeres.HasDeepBelowSplit χ (Finset.instSingleton.singleton pivot) side)
                  (∀ (polygon : Finset (Fin 9)),
                    Finset.instHasSubset.Subset polygon side →
                      Eq polygon.card 4 →
                        ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet χ polygon →
                          ErdosSzekeres.IsCapSet χ polygon))))

          And (SetLike.instMembership.mem lane ideal)
            (Eq
              (ErdosSzekeres.finiteCandidateSmallOwnerNeighbors block candidates hole
                (Finset.instSingleton.singleton ideal))
              Finset.instEmptyCollection.emptyCollection))
        (Exists fun first =>
          And (SetLike.instMembership.mem lane first)
            (Exists fun second =>
              And (SetLike.instMembership.mem lane second)
                (Exists fun owner =>
                  And (Ne first second)
                    (And
                      (Eq
                        (ErdosSzekeres.finiteCandidateSmallOwnerNeighbors block candidates hole
                          (Finset.instSingleton.singleton first))
                        (Finset.instSingleton.singleton owner))
                      (And

                            (Finset.instSingleton.singleton second))
                          (Finset.instSingleton.singleton owner))
                        (And

                            (Finset.instInsert.insert first

                          (Or (ErdosSzekeres.PascalGridIdeal.instPartialOrder.le first second)
                            (ErdosSzekeres.PascalGridIdeal.instPartialOrder.le second
                              first)))))))) →
      Exists fun anchors =>
        And (ErdosSzekeres.FiniteCandidateMinimalDeficientAnchor block candidates hole anchors)

full-ambient downset difference at the next endpoint, or their two selected
incoming endpoints cross.

type_pp:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : LinearOrder α] (κ : α → α → α → ErdosSzekeres.Turn) (s : Finset α)
  (clip : Nat) {uCap uCup x y : α} {cap cup : Nat},
  SetLike.instMembership.mem s uCap →
    SetLike.instMembership.mem s uCup →
      SetLike.instMembership.mem s x →
        SetLike.instMembership.mem s y →
          instDistribLatticeOfLinearOrder.toSemilatticeInf.lt uCap x →
            instDistribLatticeOfLinearOrder.toSemilatticeInf.lt uCup x →
              instDistribLatticeOfLinearOrder.toSemilatticeInf.lt x y →
                instLENat.le 1 cap →
                  instLENat.le 1 cup →
                    instLTNat.lt cap clip →
                      instLTNat.lt cup clip →
                        ErdosSzekeres.RankProfile.HasClippedPairRankAtLeast κ
                            ErdosSzekeres.Turn.right s clip uCap x cap →
                          ErdosSzekeres.RankProfile.HasClippedPairRankAtLeast κ
                              ErdosSzekeres.Turn.left s clip uCup x cup →
                            Not
                                (ErdosSzekeres.RankProfile.InVertexDownset κ s clip x
                                  (instHAdd.hAdd cap 1) 1) →
                              Not
                                  (ErdosSzekeres.RankProfile.InVertexDownset κ s clip x 1
                                    (instHAdd.hAdd cup 1)) →
                                Or
                                  (Exists fun a =>
                                    Exists fun b =>
                                      And (ErdosSzekeres.RankProfile.InVertexDownset κ s clip y a b)
                                        (Not
                                          (ErdosSzekeres.RankProfile.InVertexDownset κ s clip x a
                                            b)))
                                  (And (Eq (κ uCap x y) ErdosSzekeres.Turn.left)
                                    (Eq (κ uCup x y) ErdosSzekeres.Turn.right))

          Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCapSet χ right 4) →
            ErdosSzekeres.OneChangeOn χ (Finset.instUnion.union left right) →
              Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCupSet χ (Finset.instUnion.union left right) 6) →
                Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet χ left 6) →
                  Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet χ right 6) →
                    And
                      (∀ (q : Fin n),
                        SetLike.instMembership.mem right q →
                          ErdosSzekeres.HasAdjoinedCapOrStrongSixThrough χ left q)
                      (∀ (q : Fin n),
                        SetLike.instMembership.mem left q →
                          ErdosSzekeres.HasAdjoinedCapOrStrongSixThrough χ right q)

doc:
For two four-cap-free sides totaling fifteen vertices, every deleted
triple misses a crossing four-cap in the no-six-cup/no-strong-six branch.
name: ErdosSzekeres.crossingCapFour_avoiding_three_of_two_cap_free_sides_card_fifteen
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {left right deleted : Finset (Fin n)},
  Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCapSet χ left 4) →
    Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCapSet χ right 4) →
      ErdosSzekeres.OneChangeOn χ (Finset.instUnion.union left right) →
        Eq (Finset.instUnion.union left right).card 15 →
          Finset.instHasSubset.Subset deleted (Finset.instUnion.union left right) →
            Eq deleted.card 3 →
              Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCupSet χ (Finset.instUnion.union left right) 6) →
                Not
                    (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet χ (Finset.instUnion.union left right)
                      6) →
                  Exists fun cap =>
                    And
                      (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset cap
                        (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff (Finset.instUnion.union left right) deleted))
                      (And (Eq cap.card 4)
                        (And (ErdosSzekeres.IsCapSet χ cap)
                          (And (Finset.instInter.inter cap left).Nonempty
                            (Finset.instInter.inter cap right).Nonempty)))

doc:
Refined balanced branch after internal strong-six witnesses have been
redirected to the endpoint branch. Every remaining vertex carries a cap-four
or strong-six witness through itself on the opposite eleven-point side.
name: ErdosSzekeres.TwoCapFreeSidesElevenElevenThroughBranch567

doc:
Exact fifteen-vertex deletion form: after deleting any designated three
vertices, a no-six-cup/no-strong-six one-change set still contains a four-cap.
Thus its family of four-caps has transversal number at least four.
name: ErdosSzekeres.containsCapFour_avoiding_three_of_card_fifteen
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {s deleted : Finset (Fin n)},
  ErdosSzekeres.OneChangeOn χ s →
    Eq s.card 15 →
      Finset.instHasSubset.Subset deleted s →
        Eq deleted.card 3 →
          Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCupSet χ s 6) →
            Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet χ s 6) →
              ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCapSet χ (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff s deleted) 4

doc:
The packing contract is sufficient for the whole local two-side bound:
any counterexample of size at least twenty-two acquires the packing hypothesis
from the certified sixteen-vertex state.
name: ErdosSzekeres.twoCapFreeSidesBound567_of_strongSixPackingBranch

doc:

adjoined vertex.

type_pp: {n : Nat} → ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n → Finset (Fin n) → Fin n → Prop

doc:
In an eight-vertex four-cap-free one-change set, every designated vertex
can be avoided by some four-cup. This is the first structural distinction
between the sharp `7+7` model and the forbidden `7+8` boundary.
name: ErdosSzekeres.containsCupFour_avoiding_vertex_of_card_ge_eight
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {s : Finset (Fin n)} {q : Fin n},
  ErdosSzekeres.OneChangeOn χ s →
    Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCapSet χ s 4) →
      SetLike.instMembership.mem s q →
        instLENat.le 8 s.card → ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCupSet χ (s.erase q) 4

doc: Closing both witness branches closes the complete local two-side bound.
name: ErdosSzekeres.twoCapFreeSidesBound567_of_witnessBranches

doc:
When the adjoined vertex is external to the side, through-witnesses are
equivalent to exact three- or five-vertex residues contained in that side.

type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {side : Finset (Fin n)} {q : Fin n},
  Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem side q) →
    Iff (ErdosSzekeres.HasAdjoinedCapOrStrongSixThrough χ side q)
      (Or (ErdosSzekeres.HasAdjoinedCapResidue χ side q)
        (ErdosSzekeres.HasAdjoinedStrongSixResidue χ side q))

doc:
The forced endpoint failures on the right normalize to four internally
referenced middle anomalies and one exceptional final-middle fan class.
name: ErdosSzekeres.right_side_has_internal_or_final_anomalies_from_left_strongSix
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {left right polygon : Finset (Fin n)},
  Disjoint left right →
    (∀ (x : Fin n),
        SetLike.instMembership.mem left x →
          ∀ (y : Fin n), SetLike.instMembership.mem right y → instLTFin.lt x y) →
      Finset.instHasSubset.Subset polygon left →
        ∀ (hpolygonCard : Eq polygon.card 6),
          ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet χ polygon →
            Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet χ (Finset.instUnion.union left right) 7) →
              ∀ (q : Fin n),
                SetLike.instMembership.mem right q →
                  Or (ErdosSzekeres.HasInternalRightEndpointMiddleAnomaly χ polygon hpolygonCard q)
                    (ErdosSzekeres.HasFinalMiddleFanVariation χ polygon hpolygonCard q)

doc:
Refined remaining contract.  A hypothetical 22-vertex counterexample
must have a strong-six family avoiding every prescribed six-set, not merely
one designated strong witness.

doc:
Adjoining one external vertex to an eleven-vertex four-cap-free side
activates the checked twelve-vertex state.  With ambient six-cups excluded,
the result is either a strong six or a four-cap that necessarily passes
through the adjoined vertex.
name: ErdosSzekeres.adjoin_vertex_to_eleven_cap_free_side
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {ambient side : Finset (Fin n)} {q : Fin n},
  Finset.instHasSubset.Subset side ambient →
    SetLike.instMembership.mem ambient q →
      Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem side q) →
        Eq side.card 11 →
          Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCapSet χ side 4) →
            ErdosSzekeres.OneChangeOn χ ambient →
              Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCupSet χ ambient 6) →
                Or
                  (Exists fun cap =>
                    And (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset cap (Finset.instInsert.insert q side))
                      (And (Eq cap.card 4)
                        (And (ErdosSzekeres.IsCapSet χ cap) (SetLike.instMembership.mem cap q))))
                  (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet χ (Finset.instInsert.insert q side) 6)

doc:
In the no-six-cup/no-strong-six branch, every twelve-point subset already
contains a four-cap.  This is the certificate consequence used by the exact
fifteen-vertex kernel.
name: ErdosSzekeres.containsCapFour_of_oneChange_card_ge_twelve_no_cupSix_no_strongSix
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {s : Finset (Fin n)},
  ErdosSzekeres.OneChangeOn χ s →
    instLENat.le 12 s.card →
      Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCupSet χ s 6) →
        Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet χ s 6) → ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCapSet χ s 4

doc:
Sharp fixed-cardinality kernel for the no-strong-six branch. The two
ordered cap-free sides have sizes seven and eight in either orientation.

doc:
Hereditary transport of the kernel-checked twelve-vertex `(4,6,6)`
certificate.  This version only assumes the rank-three one-change law on the
ambient finite set; it does not require a decomposition tree.

type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {s : Finset (Fin n)},
  ErdosSzekeres.OneChangeOn χ s →
    instLENat.le 12 s.card →
      Or (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCapSet χ s 4)
        (Or (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCupSet χ s 6) (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet χ s 6))

certificate to an arbitrary finite one-change set.

type_pp:

doc:
On a four-cap-free set of at least twelve vertices, the checked `(4,6,6)`

type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {s : Finset (Fin n)},
  ErdosSzekeres.OneChangeOn χ s →
    instLENat.le 12 s.card →
      Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCapSet χ s 4) →
        Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCupSet χ s 6) → ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet χ s 6

doc:
In the balanced `11+11` branch, every vertex on either side participates
in a crossing four-cap through the opposite side or activates a strong six in
the opposite side plus that vertex.
name: ErdosSzekeres.eleven_eleven_vertex_dichotomies
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {left right : Finset (Fin n)},
  Disjoint left right →
    Eq left.card 11 →
      Eq right.card 11 →
        Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCapSet χ left 4) →
          Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCapSet χ right 4) →
            ErdosSzekeres.OneChangeOn χ (Finset.instUnion.union left right) →
              Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCupSet χ (Finset.instUnion.union left right) 6) →
                And
                  (∀ (q : Fin n),
                    SetLike.instMembership.mem right q →
                      Or
                        (Exists fun cap =>
                          And (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset cap (Finset.instInsert.insert q left))
                            (And (Eq cap.card 4)
                              (And (ErdosSzekeres.IsCapSet χ cap)
                                (SetLike.instMembership.mem cap q))))
                        (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet χ (Finset.instInsert.insert q left)
                          6))
                  (∀ (q : Fin n),
                    SetLike.instMembership.mem left q →
                      Or
                        (Exists fun cap =>
                          And (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset cap (Finset.instInsert.insert q right))
                            (And (Eq cap.card 4)
                              (And (ErdosSzekeres.IsCapSet χ cap)
                                (SetLike.instMembership.mem cap q))))
                        (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet χ (Finset.instInsert.insert q right)
                          6))

doc:
Balanced sharp-boundary branch left after internal-strong-six extraction.
Its fixed side sizes make this an exact `11+11` obstruction theorem.
name: ErdosSzekeres.TwoCapFreeSidesElevenElevenBranch567

doc:
Every packed strong six-set has a disjoint partner carrying six local
middle failures in each direction when strong seven-sets are forbidden.
name: ErdosSzekeres.exists_mutuallyMiddleObstructed_partner
type_pp:

  ErdosSzekeres.StrongSixAvoidsEverySix χ ambient →
    Finset.instHasSubset.Subset first ambient →
      Eq first.card 6 →
        ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet χ first →
          Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet χ ambient 7) →
            Exists fun second =>
              And (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset second ambient)
                (ErdosSzekeres.MutuallyMiddleObstructedStrongSixPair χ first second)

Symmetrically, if a strong six lies in the right side, every left-side
vertex has a left-endpoint middle failure relative to it.

type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {left right polygon : Finset (Fin n)},
  Disjoint left right →
    (∀ (x : Fin n),
        SetLike.instMembership.mem left x →
          ∀ (y : Fin n), SetLike.instMembership.mem right y → instLTFin.lt x y) →
      Finset.instHasSubset.Subset polygon right →
        Eq polygon.card 6 →
          ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet χ polygon →
            Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet χ (Finset.instUnion.union left right) 7) →

                    ErdosSzekeres.MiddleExtensionFailureRole.leftEndpoint

doc:
At total size at least twenty-two, either one cap-free side already
contains a strong six-set or the only remaining cardinality pattern is the
balanced `11+11` split.
name: ErdosSzekeres.two_cap_free_sides_contains_internal_strongSix_or_eleven_eleven
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {left right : Finset (Fin n)},
  ErdosSzekeres.OneChangeOn χ (Finset.instUnion.union left right) →
    Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCapSet χ left 4) →
      Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCapSet χ right 4) →
        Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCupSet χ (Finset.instUnion.union left right) 6) →
          instLENat.le left.card 15 →
            instLENat.le right.card 15 →
              instLENat.le 22 (instHAdd.hAdd left.card right.card) →
                Or (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet χ left 6)
                  (Or (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet χ right 6)
                    (And (Eq left.card 11) (Eq right.card 11)))

doc:
Witness-refined form of the eleven-plus-one dichotomy.  A strong six from
the adjoined set either already lies in the eleven-vertex side or uses the
adjoined vertex.
name: ErdosSzekeres.adjoin_vertex_to_eleven_cap_free_side_refined
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {ambient side : Finset (Fin n)} {q : Fin n},
  Finset.instHasSubset.Subset side ambient →
    SetLike.instMembership.mem ambient q →
      Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem side q) →
        Eq side.card 11 →
          Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCapSet χ side 4) →
            ErdosSzekeres.OneChangeOn χ ambient →
              Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCupSet χ ambient 6) →
                Or
                  (Exists fun cap =>
                    And (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset cap (Finset.instInsert.insert q side))
                      (And (Eq cap.card 4)
                        (And (ErdosSzekeres.IsCapSet χ cap) (SetLike.instMembership.mem cap q))))
                  (Or (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet χ side 6)
                    (Exists fun polygon =>
                      And (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset polygon (Finset.instInsert.insert q side))
                        (And (Eq polygon.card 6)
                          (And (ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet χ polygon)
                            (SetLike.instMembership.mem polygon q)))))

            (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff ambient (Finset.instUnion.union first second)) →
          Eq block.card blockCard →
            Exists fun third =>
              And
                (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset third
                  (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff ambient
                    (Finset.instInsert.insert a (Finset.instInsert.insert b block))))
                (And (Eq third.card witnessCard) (ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet χ third))

A deletion-packing condition with independent deletion and witness
cardinalities.
name: ErdosSzekeres.StrongPolygonAvoidsEveryDeletion
type_pp: {n : Nat} → ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n → Finset (Fin n) → Nat → Nat → Prop

doc:
A residual-only witness with the complementary cardinality is exactly the
unused part of the residual.
name: ErdosSzekeres.residualWitness_eq_residual_sdiff
type_pp:
∀ {n residualCard blockCard witnessCard : Nat} {ambient first second block third : Finset (Fin n)}
  {a b : Fin n},
  Eq (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff ambient (Finset.instUnion.union first second)).card residualCard →
    Finset.instHasSubset.Subset block
        (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff ambient (Finset.instUnion.union first second)) →
      Eq block.card blockCard →
        Finset.instHasSubset.Subset third
            (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff ambient
              (Finset.instInsert.insert a (Finset.instInsert.insert b block))) →
          Eq third.card witnessCard →
            Disjoint third first →
              Disjoint third second →
                Eq residualCard (instHAdd.hAdd blockCard witnessCard) →
                  Eq third
                    (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff
                      (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff ambient (Finset.instUnion.union first second)) block)

doc:
A hereditary one-change predecessor state supplies uniform deletion
packing whenever every deletion leaves more than its threshold.

type_pp:
∀ {n a u k deleteCard : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {ambient : Finset (Fin n)},
  ErdosSzekeres.OneChangeStateUpper a u k →
    ErdosSzekeres.OneChangeOn χ ambient →
      instLENat.le
          (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd (ErdosSzekeres.decomposableThreshold a u k) 1) deleteCard)
          ambient.card →
        Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCapSet χ ambient a) →
          Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCupSet χ ambient u) →
            ErdosSzekeres.StrongPolygonAvoidsEveryDeletion χ ambient deleteCard k

doc:
Uniform first residual leaf: if the unused residual complement is not
strong and the residual cardinality splits exactly into the deleted block and
the replacement witness, every packed replacement must touch at least one of
the two carriers.

type_pp:
∀ {n residualCard blockCard witnessCard : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n}
  {ambient first second block : Finset (Fin n)} {a b : Fin n},
  ErdosSzekeres.PairResidualEscape χ ambient first second residualCard blockCard witnessCard →
    SetLike.instMembership.mem first a →
      SetLike.instMembership.mem second b →
        Finset.instHasSubset.Subset block
            (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff ambient (Finset.instUnion.union first second)) →
          Eq block.card blockCard →
            Eq residualCard (instHAdd.hAdd blockCard witnessCard) →
              Not
                  (ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet χ
                    (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff
                      (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff ambient (Finset.instUnion.union first second))
                      block)) →
                Exists fun third =>
                  And
                    (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset third
                      (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff ambient
                        (Finset.instInsert.insert a (Finset.instInsert.insert b block))))
                    (And (Eq third.card witnessCard)
                      (And (ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet χ third)
                        (Or (Not (Disjoint third first)) (Not (Disjoint third second)))))

Generic finite-set extraction of a pair-residual escape from deletion

    Finset.instHasSubset.Subset first ambient →

  {a b : Fin n},

doc:
The full packed internal-pair hypotheses feed the parameter-uniform
residual-escape theorem at `(carrier,residual,block,witness) = (6,10,4,6)`.
name: ErdosSzekeres.packedInternalPair_has_fourResidualEscape_via_generic
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {left right first second : Finset (Fin n)},
  Disjoint left right →
    Eq (instHAdd.hAdd left.card right.card) 22 →
      ErdosSzekeres.StrongSixAvoidsEverySix χ (Finset.instUnion.union left right) →
        Or (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset first left) (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset first right) →
          Finset.instHasSubset.Subset second (Finset.instUnion.union left right) →
            ErdosSzekeres.MutuallyMiddleObstructedStrongSixPair χ first second →
              ErdosSzekeres.PackedInternalPairFourResidualEscape χ
                (Finset.instUnion.union left right) first second

doc:
Complementing two bad six-subsets of a ten-point residual gives two
distinct four-block probes whose unused residual six-sets are non-strong.
name: ErdosSzekeres.exists_two_fourBlocks_with_nonStrong_residual_complements
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {ambient residual : Finset (Fin n)},
  Finset.instHasSubset.Subset residual ambient →
    Eq residual.card 10 →
      Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet χ ambient 7) →
        Exists fun block₁ =>
          Exists fun block₂ =>
            And (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset block₁ residual)
              (And (Eq block₁.card 4)
                (And (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset block₂ residual)
                  (And (Eq block₂.card 4)
                    (And (Ne block₁ block₂)
                      (And
                        (Not
                          (ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet χ
                            (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff residual block₁)))
                        (Not
                          (ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet χ
                            (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff residual block₂))))))))

doc:

type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {ambient first second block : Finset (Fin n)}
  {a b : Fin n},
  ErdosSzekeres.PackedInternalPairFourResidualEscape χ ambient first second →
    SetLike.instMembership.mem first a →

                  (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff

                And
                  (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset third
                    (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff ambient
                      (Finset.instInsert.insert a (Finset.instInsert.insert b block))))
                  (And (Eq third.card 6)
                    (And (ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet χ third)
                      (Or

                          ErdosSzekeres.PairEscapeOccupancy.oneCarrier)

doc:
Strong-seven avoidance supplies two distinct residual probes whose packed
strong-six escapes both touch at least one designated carrier.  This removes
the residual-only terminal class from the exact state-567 branch.
name: ErdosSzekeres.packedInternalPair_has_two_carrierTouchingEscapes
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {ambient first second : Finset (Fin n)},
  ErdosSzekeres.PackedInternalPairFourResidualEscape χ ambient first second →
    Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet χ ambient 7) →
      ∀ {a b : Fin n},
        SetLike.instMembership.mem first a →
          SetLike.instMembership.mem second b →
            Exists fun block₁ =>
              Exists fun block₂ =>
                Exists fun third₁ =>
                  Exists fun third₂ =>
                    And
                      (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset block₁
                        (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff ambient (Finset.instUnion.union first second)))
                      (And (Eq block₁.card 4)
                        (And
                          (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset block₂
                            (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff ambient (Finset.instUnion.union first second)))
                          (And (Eq block₂.card 4)
                            (And (Ne block₁ block₂)
                              (And
                                (Not
                                  (ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet χ
                                    (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff
                                      (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff ambient
                                        (Finset.instUnion.union first second))
                                      block₁)))
                                (And
                                  (Not
                                    (ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet χ
                                      (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff
                                        (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff ambient
                                          (Finset.instUnion.union first second))
                                        block₂)))
                                  (And
                                    (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset third₁
                                      (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff ambient
                                        (Finset.instInsert.insert a
                                          (Finset.instInsert.insert b block₁))))
                                    (And (Eq third₁.card 6)
                                      (And (ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet χ third₁)
                                        (And
                                          (Or
                                            (ErdosSzekeres.HasPairEscapeOccupancy first second
                                              third₁ ErdosSzekeres.PairEscapeOccupancy.oneCarrier)
                                            (ErdosSzekeres.HasPairEscapeOccupancy first second
                                              third₁ ErdosSzekeres.PairEscapeOccupancy.twoCarrier))
                                          (And
                                            (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset third₂
                                              (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff ambient
                                                (Finset.instInsert.insert a
                                                  (Finset.instInsert.insert b block₂))))
                                            (And (Eq third₂.card 6)
                                              (And (ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet χ third₂)
                                                (Or
                                                  (ErdosSzekeres.HasPairEscapeOccupancy first second
                                                    third₂
                                                    ErdosSzekeres.PairEscapeOccupancy.oneCarrier)
                                                  (ErdosSzekeres.HasPairEscapeOccupancy first second
                                                    third₂
                                                    ErdosSzekeres.PairEscapeOccupancy.twoCarrier)))))))))))))))

doc:

                                (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff ambient

                              (And (Eq third.card 6)

doc:
In the exact residual-ten packed context, the thirty probes force either
two distinct witnesses in the same coarse occupancy class or an incident
strong six containing at least three vertices of the two original carriers.
name: ErdosSzekeres.exists_sameOccupancyCollision_or_threeCarrierWitness567
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {ambient first second : Finset (Fin n)},
  ErdosSzekeres.MutuallyMiddleObstructedStrongSixPair χ first second →
    ErdosSzekeres.PackedInternalPairFourResidualEscape χ ambient first second →
      Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet χ ambient 7) →
        ∀ {a b : Fin n},
          SetLike.instMembership.mem first a →
            SetLike.instMembership.mem second b →
              Or
                (Exists fun third₁ =>
                  And
                    (SetLike.instMembership.mem
                      (ErdosSzekeres.CarrierTouchingProbeWitnesses567 χ ambient first second a b)
                      third₁)
                    (Exists fun third₂ =>
                      And
                        (SetLike.instMembership.mem
                          (ErdosSzekeres.CarrierTouchingProbeWitnesses567 χ ambient first second a
                            b)

        have residual := Finset.instSDiff.sdiff ambient (Finset.instUnion.union first second);
        have badSix := Finset.instSDiff.sdiff residual block;
        have residualCore := Finset.instInter.inter third residual;
        have addedCarrier := Finset.instInter.inter third (Finset.instUnion.union first second);
        have removedResidual := Finset.instSDiff.sdiff badSix residualCore;

          (And (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset residualCore badSix)

doc:
Exact frozen first-stage contract: the packed pair yields either a genuine
same-occupancy collision at one anchor pair or the canonical balanced
four-grid.  The mixed profile is eliminated only by the all-order theorem in
`packedInternalPair_has_balancedGrid567_of_noCollision`.
name: ErdosSzekeres.packedInternalPair_has_sameOccupancyCollision_or_balancedGrid567
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {ambient first second : Finset (Fin n)},
  ErdosSzekeres.MutuallyMiddleObstructedStrongSixPair χ first second →
    Finset.instHasSubset.Subset (Finset.instUnion.union first second) ambient →
      ErdosSzekeres.PackedInternalPairFourResidualEscape χ ambient first second →
        ErdosSzekeres.OneChangeOn χ ambient →
          Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCapSet χ ambient 5) →
            Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCupSet χ ambient 6) →
              Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet χ ambient 7) →
                Or
                  (Exists fun a =>
                    And (SetLike.instMembership.mem first a)
                      (Exists fun b =>
                        And (SetLike.instMembership.mem second b)
                          (Exists fun third₁ =>
                            And
                              (SetLike.instMembership.mem
                                (ErdosSzekeres.CarrierTouchingProbeWitnesses567 χ ambient first
                                  second a b)
                                third₁)
                              (Exists fun third₂ =>
                                And
                                  (SetLike.instMembership.mem
                                    (ErdosSzekeres.CarrierTouchingProbeWitnesses567 χ ambient first
                                      second a b)
                                    third₂)
                                  (And (Ne third₁ third₂)
                                    (ErdosSzekeres.SameCarrierTouchingOccupancy567 first second
                                      third₁ third₂))))))
                  (Exists fun witnesses =>
                    And
                      (Eq witnesses
                        (ErdosSzekeres.CarrierOnlyProbeWitnessSets567 χ ambient first second))
                      (And
                        (ErdosSzekeres.IsCarrierOnlyOmissionRectangleSystem567 χ first second
                          witnesses)
                        (ErdosSzekeres.IsFourDisjointThreeByThreeOmissionGrid567 first second
                          witnesses)))

doc:
A balanced four-grid has a three-point carrier transversal: two points in
`first` and one in `second`, meeting both carriers and every strong grid

              (And (Eq transversal.card 3)
                (And (Not (Disjoint transversal first))
