doc: Left-side vertices which carry a strong-five residue on the right.
name: ErdosSzekeres.LeftStrongResidueCarriers
type_pp: {n : Nat} → ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n → Finset (Fin n) → Finset (Fin n) → Finset (Fin n)

doc:
All vertices which occur as the singleton side of an extreme crossing
strong six.
name: ErdosSzekeres.StrongResidueCarriers
type_pp: {n : Nat} → ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n → Finset (Fin n) → Finset (Fin n) → Finset (Fin n)

name: ErdosSzekeres.mem_strongResidueCarriersInto_iff
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {external side : Finset (Fin n)} {q : Fin n},
  Iff (SetLike.instMembership.mem (ErdosSzekeres.StrongResidueCarriersInto χ external side) q)
    (And (SetLike.instMembership.mem external q)
      (ErdosSzekeres.HasAdjoinedStrongSixResidue χ side q))

name: ErdosSzekeres.mem_rightStrongResidueCarriers_iff
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {left right : Finset (Fin n)} {q : Fin n},
  Iff (SetLike.instMembership.mem (ErdosSzekeres.RightStrongResidueCarriers χ left right) q)
    (And (SetLike.instMembership.mem right q) (ErdosSzekeres.HasAdjoinedStrongSixResidue χ left q))

doc: Right-side vertices which carry a strong-five residue on the left.
name: ErdosSzekeres.RightStrongResidueCarriers
type_pp: {n : Nat} → ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n → Finset (Fin n) → Finset (Fin n) → Finset (Fin n)

name: ErdosSzekeres.mem_strongResidueCarriers_iff
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {left right : Finset (Fin n)} {q : Fin n},
  Iff (SetLike.instMembership.mem (ErdosSzekeres.StrongResidueCarriers χ left right) q)
    (Or
      (And (SetLike.instMembership.mem left q)
        (ErdosSzekeres.HasAdjoinedStrongSixResidue χ right q))
      (And (SetLike.instMembership.mem right q)
        (ErdosSzekeres.HasAdjoinedStrongSixResidue χ left q)))

doc: Intersections of one set with two disjoint sides remain disjoint.
name: ErdosSzekeres.side_intersections_disjoint
type_pp:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] {left right polygon : Finset α},
  Disjoint left right →
    Disjoint (Finset.instInter.inter polygon left) (Finset.instInter.inter polygon right)

doc: Vertices in one set which carry a strong-five residue in another set.
name: ErdosSzekeres.StrongResidueCarriersInto
type_pp: {n : Nat} → ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n → Finset (Fin n) → Finset (Fin n) → Finset (Fin n)

doc:
Conditional packing-to-residue bridge: after excluding middle crossing
splits, at least four vertices on one side carry strong-five residues.
name: ErdosSzekeres.four_strongResidueCarriers_on_one_side_of_packing_no_middle_splits
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {left right : Finset (Fin n)},
  Disjoint left right →
    Eq left.card 11 →
      Eq right.card 11 →
        ErdosSzekeres.StrongSixAvoidsEverySix χ (Finset.instUnion.union left right) →
          Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet χ left 6) →
            Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet χ right 6) →
              Not (ErdosSzekeres.HasCrossingStrongSixSplit χ left right 2 4) →
                Not (ErdosSzekeres.HasCrossingStrongSixSplit χ left right 3 3) →
                  Not (ErdosSzekeres.HasCrossingStrongSixSplit χ left right 4 2) →
                    Or (instLENat.le 4 (ErdosSzekeres.LeftStrongResidueCarriers χ left right).card)
                      (instLENat.le 4 (ErdosSzekeres.RightStrongResidueCarriers χ left right).card)

doc:
Three strong-residue carrier vertices into an eleven-set have residue
bases with a pair overlap.
name: ErdosSzekeres.three_strongResidueCarriersInto_have_pairOverlap
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {external side : Finset (Fin n)},
  Eq side.card 11 →
    instLENat.le 3 (ErdosSzekeres.StrongResidueCarriersInto χ external side).card →
      ErdosSzekeres.HasThreeStrongResiduesWithPairOverlap χ external side

doc:
A `1+5` crossing strong six supplies a strong-five residue on the right
for its unique left vertex.
name: ErdosSzekeres.one_five_crossingStrongSix_gives_left_strongResidue
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {left right : Finset (Fin n)},
  ErdosSzekeres.HasCrossingStrongSixSplit χ left right 1 5 →
    Exists fun q =>
      And (SetLike.instMembership.mem left q) (ErdosSzekeres.HasAdjoinedStrongSixResidue χ right q)

doc:
If all three middle crossing splits are absent, the deletion packing
forces at least seven extreme-split carrier vertices.
name: ErdosSzekeres.seven_strongResidueCarriers_of_packing_no_middle_splits
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {left right : Finset (Fin n)},
  Disjoint left right →
    Eq left.card 11 →
      Eq right.card 11 →
        ErdosSzekeres.StrongSixAvoidsEverySix χ (Finset.instUnion.union left right) →
          Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet χ left 6) →
            Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet χ right 6) →
              Not (ErdosSzekeres.HasCrossingStrongSixSplit χ left right 2 4) →
                Not (ErdosSzekeres.HasCrossingStrongSixSplit χ left right 3 3) →
                  Not (ErdosSzekeres.HasCrossingStrongSixSplit χ left right 4 2) →
                    instLENat.le 7 (ErdosSzekeres.StrongResidueCarriers χ left right).card

doc:
An explicit `5+1` strong six supplies a strong-five residue at its unique
right vertex, which remains a member of the original polygon.
name: ErdosSzekeres.five_one_strongSix_gives_right_strongResidue_at
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {left right polygon : Finset (Fin n)},
  Finset.instHasSubset.Subset polygon (Finset.instUnion.union left right) →
    ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet χ polygon →
      Eq (Finset.instInter.inter polygon left).card 5 →
        Eq (Finset.instInter.inter polygon right).card 1 →
          Exists fun q =>
            And (SetLike.instMembership.mem polygon q)
              (And (SetLike.instMembership.mem right q)
                (ErdosSzekeres.HasAdjoinedStrongSixResidue χ left q))

doc:
A set contained in two disjoint sides is the union of its two side
intersections.
name: ErdosSzekeres.union_side_intersections_eq
type_pp:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] {left right polygon : Finset α},
  Finset.instHasSubset.Subset polygon (Finset.instUnion.union left right) →
    Eq
      (Finset.instUnion.union (Finset.instInter.inter polygon left)
        (Finset.instInter.inter polygon right))
      polygon

name: ErdosSzekeres.mem_leftStrongResidueCarriers_iff
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {left right : Finset (Fin n)} {q : Fin n},
  Iff (SetLike.instMembership.mem (ErdosSzekeres.LeftStrongResidueCarriers χ left right) q)
    (And (SetLike.instMembership.mem left q) (ErdosSzekeres.HasAdjoinedStrongSixResidue χ right q))

doc:
Seven total extreme-split carriers put at least four carriers on one side
of the balanced cut.
name: ErdosSzekeres.four_strongResidueCarriers_on_one_side_of_seven
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {left right : Finset (Fin n)},
  Disjoint left right →
    instLENat.le 7 (ErdosSzekeres.StrongResidueCarriers χ left right).card →
      Or (instLENat.le 4 (ErdosSzekeres.LeftStrongResidueCarriers χ left right).card)
        (instLENat.le 4 (ErdosSzekeres.RightStrongResidueCarriers χ left right).card)

doc:
In the balanced no-internal-strong-six branch, every packed witness left
inside the ambient set has exactly one of the five proper crossing splits.
name: ErdosSzekeres.strongSix_has_proper_crossing_split
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {left right polygon : Finset (Fin n)},
  Disjoint left right →
    Finset.instHasSubset.Subset polygon (Finset.instUnion.union left right) →
      Eq polygon.card 6 →
        ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet χ polygon →
          Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet χ left 6) →
            Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet χ right 6) →
              Or
                (And (Eq (Finset.instInter.inter polygon left).card 1)
                  (Eq (Finset.instInter.inter polygon right).card 5))
                (Or
                  (And (Eq (Finset.instInter.inter polygon left).card 2)
                    (Eq (Finset.instInter.inter polygon right).card 4))
                  (Or
                    (And (Eq (Finset.instInter.inter polygon left).card 3)
                      (Eq (Finset.instInter.inter polygon right).card 3))
                    (Or
                      (And (Eq (Finset.instInter.inter polygon left).card 4)
                        (Eq (Finset.instInter.inter polygon right).card 2))
                      (And (Eq (Finset.instInter.inter polygon left).card 5)
                        (Eq (Finset.instInter.inter polygon right).card 1)))))

doc:
Conversely, a left vertex with a strong-five residue on the right gives
a `1+5` crossing strong six.
name: ErdosSzekeres.left_strongResidue_gives_one_five_crossingStrongSix
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {left right : Finset (Fin n)} {q : Fin n},
  Disjoint left right →
    SetLike.instMembership.mem left q →
      ErdosSzekeres.HasAdjoinedStrongSixResidue χ right q →
        ErdosSzekeres.HasCrossingStrongSixSplit χ left right 1 5

doc:
An explicit `1+5` strong six supplies a strong-five residue at its unique
left vertex, which remains a member of the original polygon.
name: ErdosSzekeres.one_five_strongSix_gives_left_strongResidue_at
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {left right polygon : Finset (Fin n)},
  Finset.instHasSubset.Subset polygon (Finset.instUnion.union left right) →
    ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet χ polygon →
      Eq (Finset.instInter.inter polygon left).card 1 →
        Eq (Finset.instInter.inter polygon right).card 5 →
          Exists fun q =>
            And (SetLike.instMembership.mem polygon q)
              (And (SetLike.instMembership.mem left q)
                (ErdosSzekeres.HasAdjoinedStrongSixResidue χ right q))

doc:
Conversely, a right vertex with a strong-five residue on the left gives
a `5+1` crossing strong six.
name: ErdosSzekeres.right_strongResidue_gives_five_one_crossingStrongSix
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {left right : Finset (Fin n)} {q : Fin n},
  Disjoint left right →
    SetLike.instMembership.mem right q →
      ErdosSzekeres.HasAdjoinedStrongSixResidue χ left q →
        ErdosSzekeres.HasCrossingStrongSixSplit χ left right 5 1

doc:
With middle crossing splits excluded, the strong-six packing activates
the three-residue pair-overlap theorem on one side of the balanced cut.
name: ErdosSzekeres.packing_no_middle_splits_gives_three_residues_with_pairOverlap
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {left right : Finset (Fin n)},
  Disjoint left right →
    Eq left.card 11 →
      Eq right.card 11 →
        ErdosSzekeres.StrongSixAvoidsEverySix χ (Finset.instUnion.union left right) →
          Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet χ left 6) →
            Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet χ right 6) →
              Not (ErdosSzekeres.HasCrossingStrongSixSplit χ left right 2 4) →
                Not (ErdosSzekeres.HasCrossingStrongSixSplit χ left right 3 3) →
                  Not (ErdosSzekeres.HasCrossingStrongSixSplit χ left right 4 2) →
                    Or (ErdosSzekeres.HasThreeStrongResiduesWithPairOverlap χ left right)
                      (ErdosSzekeres.HasThreeStrongResiduesWithPairOverlap χ right left)

doc:
A strong six-set whose intersections with the two sides have prescribed
cardinalities.
name: ErdosSzekeres.HasCrossingStrongSixSplit
type_pp: {n : Nat} → ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n → Finset (Fin n) → Finset (Fin n) → Nat → Nat → Prop

doc:
A strong six avoiding a cap five and a cup six has middle-word weight one
or two.
name: ErdosSzekeres.strongSix_middle_word_weight_one_or_two
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {polygon : Finset (Fin n)}
  (hcard : Eq polygon.card 6),
  ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet χ polygon →
    Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCapSet χ polygon 5) →
      Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCupSet χ polygon 6) →
        ErdosSzekeres.StrongSixMiddleWordWeightOneOrTwo χ polygon hcard

doc:
A fresh right-endpoint failure needs no global after-polygon hypothesis:
it normalizes to an internal middle-word anomaly or the final boundary fan.
name: ErdosSzekeres.rightEndpoint_failure_internal_or_final_without_order
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {polygon : Finset (Fin n)} {q : Fin n}
  (hcard : Eq polygon.card 6),
  ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet χ polygon →
    ErdosSzekeres.HasMiddleExtensionFailureWithRole χ polygon q
        ErdosSzekeres.MiddleExtensionFailureRole.rightEndpoint →
      Or (ErdosSzekeres.HasInternalRightEndpointMiddleAnomaly χ polygon hcard q)
        (ErdosSzekeres.HasFinalMiddleFanVariation χ polygon hcard q)

doc:
If all four internal middle positions of a strong six are left, the whole
six-set is a cup.
name: ErdosSzekeres.strongSix_all_left_middles_force_cupSix
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {polygon : Finset (Fin n)}
  (hcard : Eq polygon.card 6),
  ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet χ polygon →
    Eq
        (χ
          { i := (instFunLikeOrderEmbedding (Fin 6) (Fin n)).coe (polygon.orderEmbOfFin hcard) 0,
            j := (instFunLikeOrderEmbedding (Fin 6) (Fin n)).coe (polygon.orderEmbOfFin hcard) 1,
            k := (instFunLikeOrderEmbedding (Fin 6) (Fin n)).coe (polygon.orderEmbOfFin hcard) 5,
            hij := ⋯, hjk := ⋯ })
        ErdosSzekeres.Turn.left →
      Eq
          (χ
            { i := (instFunLikeOrderEmbedding (Fin 6) (Fin n)).coe (polygon.orderEmbOfFin hcard) 0,
              j := (instFunLikeOrderEmbedding (Fin 6) (Fin n)).coe (polygon.orderEmbOfFin hcard) 2,
              k := (instFunLikeOrderEmbedding (Fin 6) (Fin n)).coe (polygon.orderEmbOfFin hcard) 5,
              hij := ⋯, hjk := ⋯ })
          ErdosSzekeres.Turn.left →
        Eq
            (χ
              {
                i :=
                  (instFunLikeOrderEmbedding (Fin 6) (Fin n)).coe (polygon.orderEmbOfFin hcard) 0,
                j :=
                  (instFunLikeOrderEmbedding (Fin 6) (Fin n)).coe (polygon.orderEmbOfFin hcard) 3,
                k :=
                  (instFunLikeOrderEmbedding (Fin 6) (Fin n)).coe (polygon.orderEmbOfFin hcard) 5,
                hij := ⋯, hjk := ⋯ })
            ErdosSzekeres.Turn.left →
          Eq
              (χ
                {
                  i :=
                    (instFunLikeOrderEmbedding (Fin 6) (Fin n)).coe (polygon.orderEmbOfFin hcard) 0,
                  j :=
                    (instFunLikeOrderEmbedding (Fin 6) (Fin n)).coe (polygon.orderEmbOfFin hcard) 4,
                  k :=
                    (instFunLikeOrderEmbedding (Fin 6) (Fin n)).coe (polygon.orderEmbOfFin hcard) 5,
                  hij := ⋯, hjk := ⋯ })
              ErdosSzekeres.Turn.left →
            ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCupSet χ polygon 6

doc:
Three right-colored internal middle positions of a strong six form a cap
five through the two endpoints.
name: ErdosSzekeres.strongSix_three_right_middles_force_capFive
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {polygon : Finset (Fin n)}
  (hcard : Eq polygon.card 6),
  ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet χ polygon →
    ∀ (a b c : Fin 6) (ha0 : instLTFin.lt 0 a) (hab : instLTFin.lt a b) (hbc : instLTFin.lt b c)
      (hc5 : instLTFin.lt c 5),
      Eq
          (χ
            { i := (instFunLikeOrderEmbedding (Fin 6) (Fin n)).coe (polygon.orderEmbOfFin hcard) 0,
              j := (instFunLikeOrderEmbedding (Fin 6) (Fin n)).coe (polygon.orderEmbOfFin hcard) a,
              k := (instFunLikeOrderEmbedding (Fin 6) (Fin n)).coe (polygon.orderEmbOfFin hcard) 5,
              hij := ⋯, hjk := ⋯ })
          ErdosSzekeres.Turn.right →
        Eq
            (χ
              {
                i :=
                  (instFunLikeOrderEmbedding (Fin 6) (Fin n)).coe (polygon.orderEmbOfFin hcard) 0,
                j :=
                  (instFunLikeOrderEmbedding (Fin 6) (Fin n)).coe (polygon.orderEmbOfFin hcard) b,
                k :=
                  (instFunLikeOrderEmbedding (Fin 6) (Fin n)).coe (polygon.orderEmbOfFin hcard) 5,
                hij := ⋯, hjk := ⋯ })
            ErdosSzekeres.Turn.right →
          Eq
              (χ
                {
                  i :=
                    (instFunLikeOrderEmbedding (Fin 6) (Fin n)).coe (polygon.orderEmbOfFin hcard) 0,
                  j :=
                    (instFunLikeOrderEmbedding (Fin 6) (Fin n)).coe (polygon.orderEmbOfFin hcard) c,
                  k :=
                    (instFunLikeOrderEmbedding (Fin 6) (Fin n)).coe (polygon.orderEmbOfFin hcard) 5,
                  hij := ⋯, hjk := ⋯ })
              ErdosSzekeres.Turn.right →
            ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCapSet χ polygon 5

doc:
The final five-way local state for a failed extension by a vertex on
either side of the cut. Every branch is now an explicit anomaly or fan
variation; no bare extension-failure role remains.
name: ErdosSzekeres.HasFullyNormalizedCutFailure
type_pp:
{n : Nat} →
  ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n →
    Finset (Fin n) → Finset (Fin n) → (polygon : Finset (Fin n)) → Eq polygon.card 6 → Fin n → Prop

doc:
The middle-word-referenced state refines to the explicit five-way state
by normalizing its three remaining raw roles.
name: ErdosSzekeres.middleWordReferenced_failure_refines_to_fullyNormalized
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {left right polygon : Finset (Fin n)} {q : Fin n}
  (hcard : Eq polygon.card 6),
  ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet χ polygon →
    ErdosSzekeres.HasCutMiddleWordReferencedFailure χ left right polygon hcard q →
      ErdosSzekeres.HasFullyNormalizedCutFailure χ left right polygon hcard q

doc:
A fresh shared-middle role is exactly a fan variation whose four
endpoints lie in the original polygon.
name: ErdosSzekeres.middleRole_failure_has_freshMiddleFanVariation
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {polygon : Finset (Fin n)} {q : Fin n},
  ErdosSzekeres.HasMiddleExtensionFailureWithRole χ polygon q
      ErdosSzekeres.MiddleExtensionFailureRole.middle →
    ErdosSzekeres.HasFreshMiddleFanVariation χ polygon q

doc:
Packing now lands directly in the complete bounded crossing state: the
deleted strong six has a disjoint partner, both have proper crossing splits
and bounded middle words, and all twelve failures have an explicit five-way
anomaly/fan normalization.
name: ErdosSzekeres.packedStrongSix_has_bounded_crossing_state_partner
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {left right first : Finset (Fin n)},
  Disjoint left right →
    (∀ (x : Fin n),
        SetLike.instMembership.mem left x →
          ∀ (y : Fin n), SetLike.instMembership.mem right y → instLTFin.lt x y) →
      Finset.instHasSubset.Subset first (Finset.instUnion.union left right) →
        Eq first.card 6 →
          ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet χ first →
            ErdosSzekeres.StrongSixAvoidsEverySix χ (Finset.instUnion.union left right) →
              Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet χ left 6) →
                Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet χ right 6) →
                  Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCapSet χ (Finset.instUnion.union left right) 5) →
                    Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCupSet χ (Finset.instUnion.union left right) 6) →
                      Not
                          (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet χ
                            (Finset.instUnion.union left right) 7) →
                        Exists fun second =>
                          Exists fun _hsecondSub =>
                            Exists fun hmutual =>
                              And (ErdosSzekeres.StrongSixMiddleWordWeightOneOrTwo χ first ⋯)
                                (And (ErdosSzekeres.StrongSixMiddleWordWeightOneOrTwo χ second ⋯)
                                  (And
                                    (ErdosSzekeres.HasProperStrongSixCrossingSplit first left right)
                                    (And
                                      (ErdosSzekeres.HasProperStrongSixCrossingSplit second left
                                        right)
                                      (And
                                        (∀ (q : Fin n),
                                          SetLike.instMembership.mem second q →
                                            ErdosSzekeres.HasFullyNormalizedCutFailure χ left right
                                              first ⋯ q)
                                        (∀ (q : Fin n),
                                          SetLike.instMembership.mem first q →
                                            ErdosSzekeres.HasFullyNormalizedCutFailure χ left right
                                              second ⋯ q)))))

doc:
The side-aware finite state of a failed extension across an ordered cut.
On the vertex's own side, the extreme role pointing back across the cut is
replaced by the stronger conclusion that its comparison core is local.
name: ErdosSzekeres.HasCutLocalizedMiddleFailure
type_pp:
{n : Nat} →
  ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n → Finset (Fin n) → Finset (Fin n) → Finset (Fin n) → Fin n → Prop

doc:
If a left-side vertex occurs as the right endpoint of a crossing
polygon's failed comparison, all three earlier vertices of that comparison
are forced onto the left side.
name: ErdosSzekeres.rightEndpoint_failure_of_left_vertex_has_left_core
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {left right polygon : Finset (Fin n)} {q : Fin n},
  (∀ (x : Fin n),
      SetLike.instMembership.mem left x →
        ∀ (y : Fin n), SetLike.instMembership.mem right y → instLTFin.lt x y) →
    Finset.instHasSubset.Subset polygon (Finset.instUnion.union left right) →
      SetLike.instMembership.mem left q →
        ErdosSzekeres.HasMiddleExtensionFailureWithRole χ polygon q
            ErdosSzekeres.MiddleExtensionFailureRole.rightEndpoint →
          ErdosSzekeres.HasRightEndpointFailureWithLeftCore χ polygon left q

doc:
Every failed extension by a right-side vertex has one of two interleaving
roles, or else its left-endpoint role has a fully right-localized core.
name: ErdosSzekeres.right_vertex_failure_role_or_right_core
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {left right polygon : Finset (Fin n)} {q : Fin n},
  (∀ (x : Fin n),
      SetLike.instMembership.mem left x →
        ∀ (y : Fin n), SetLike.instMembership.mem right y → instLTFin.lt x y) →
    Finset.instHasSubset.Subset polygon (Finset.instUnion.union left right) →
      SetLike.instMembership.mem right q →
        ErdosSzekeres.HasMiddleExtensionFailure χ polygon q →
          Or (ErdosSzekeres.HasLeftEndpointFailureWithRightCore χ polygon right q)
            (Or
              (ErdosSzekeres.HasMiddleExtensionFailureWithRole χ polygon q
                ErdosSzekeres.MiddleExtensionFailureRole.middle)
              (ErdosSzekeres.HasMiddleExtensionFailureWithRole χ polygon q
                ErdosSzekeres.MiddleExtensionFailureRole.rightEndpoint))

doc:
A localized right-endpoint failure against a crossing strong six is
either one triple disagreeing with the strong six's middle-word color, or a
genuine fan variation at that same internal middle.
name: ErdosSzekeres.rightEndpoint_leftCore_internal_anomaly_or_fan
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {left right polygon : Finset (Fin n)} {q : Fin n},
  (∀ (x : Fin n),
      SetLike.instMembership.mem left x →

              (χ

                  k := (instFunLikeOrderEmbedding (Fin 6) (Fin n)).coe e 5, hij := ⋯, hjk := ⋯ }))

The same terminal four-cap simultaneously carries the nine genuine
outer-tail bridges and the lowest-split `1+3`/`2+2` alternative.  In the
`1+3` branch, the strict `(5,5,8)` predecessor bounds the lower child by 20.

  ErdosSzekeres.IsDecomposableOn χ upper →
    ErdosSzekeres.HasDeepBelowSplit χ (Finset.instSingleton.singleton q) upper →
      Eq upper.card 32 →
        ErdosSzekeres.DecomposableStateUpper 5 5 8 →
          Not
              (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCapSet χ
                (Finset.instUnion.union (Finset.instSingleton.singleton q) upper) 5) →
            Not
                (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCupSet χ
                  (Finset.instUnion.union (Finset.instSingleton.singleton q) upper) 7) →
              Not
                  (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet χ
                    (Finset.instUnion.union (Finset.instSingleton.singleton q) upper) 8) →
                Exists fun cap =>
                  Exists fun hcap =>
                    And
                      (Not
                        (Exists fun inner =>
                          Exists fun hinner =>
                            (ErdosSzekeres.finsetSweepInterval inner ⋯).StrictlyInside
                              (ErdosSzekeres.finsetSweepInterval cap ⋯)))
                      (And ((ErdosSzekeres.finsetSweepInterval cap ⋯).StraddlesCut q.val)
                        (And
                          (instLENat.le 9
                            (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff
                                (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff upper
                                  (ErdosSzekeres.openSweepSpanVertices upper cap ⋯))
                                cap).card)
                          (And
                            (∀ (x : Fin n),
                              SetLike.instMembership.mem
                                  (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff
                                    (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff upper
                                      (ErdosSzekeres.openSweepSpanVertices upper cap ⋯))
                                    cap)
                                  x →
                                Or
                                  (ErdosSzekeres.RealizesCapFourFailureSignature χ cap ⋯ x
                                    ErdosSzekeres.CapFourFailureSignature.before)
                                  (ErdosSzekeres.RealizesCapFourFailureSignature χ cap ⋯ x
                                    ErdosSzekeres.CapFourFailureSignature.after))
                            (Exists fun tree =>
                              Exists fun path =>
                                Exists fun node =>
                                  And (Eq (tree.splitAtPath path) (Option.some node))
                                    (And
                                      (ErdosSzekeres.DecompositionTree.IsLowestSeparatingPath cap
                                        tree path)
                                      (Or
                                        (And (Eq (Finset.instInter.inter cap node.lower).card 1)
                                          (And (Eq (Finset.instInter.inter cap node.upper).card 3)
                                            (And (Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCupSet χ node.lower 5))
                                              (instLENat.le node.lower.card 20))))
                                        (And (Eq (Finset.instInter.inter cap node.lower).card 2)
                                          (And (Eq (Finset.instInter.inter cap node.upper).card 2)
                                            (Not
                                              (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCupSet χ node.lower 6))))))))))

doc:
The actual singleton-lower `(5,7,8)` obstruction carries at least six
essential terminal tails.  Each has a private secondary cap and is routed at
the terminal cap's lowest decomposition node.
name: ErdosSzekeres.exists_terminalFourCap_sixPrivateRoutedTailTransversal_at_578
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {q : Fin n} {upper : Finset (Fin n)},
  ErdosSzekeres.IsDecomposableOn χ upper →
    ErdosSzekeres.HasDeepBelowSplit χ (Finset.instSingleton.singleton q) upper →
      Eq upper.card 32 →
        ErdosSzekeres.DecomposableStateUpper 5 5 8 →
          Not
              (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCapSet χ
                (Finset.instUnion.union (Finset.instSingleton.singleton q) upper) 5) →
            Not
                (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCupSet χ
                  (Finset.instUnion.union (Finset.instSingleton.singleton q) upper) 7) →
              Not
                  (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet χ
                    (Finset.instUnion.union (Finset.instSingleton.singleton q) upper) 8) →
                Exists fun cap =>
                  Exists fun hcap =>
                    And
                      (Not
                        (Exists fun inner =>
                          Exists fun hinner =>
                            (ErdosSzekeres.finsetSweepInterval inner ⋯).StrictlyInside
                              (ErdosSzekeres.finsetSweepInterval cap ⋯)))
                      (And ((ErdosSzekeres.finsetSweepInterval cap ⋯).StraddlesCut q.val)
                        (have tails :=
                          Finset.instSDiff.sdiff
                            (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff upper
                              (ErdosSzekeres.openSweepSpanVertices upper cap ⋯))
                            cap;
                        And (instLENat.le 9 tails.card)
                          (Exists fun tree =>
                            Exists fun path =>
                              Exists fun node =>
                                And (Eq (tree.splitAtPath path) (Option.some node))
                                  (And
                                    (ErdosSzekeres.DecompositionTree.IsLowestSeparatingPath cap tree
                                      path)
                                    (And
                                      (Or
                                        (And (Eq (Finset.instInter.inter cap node.lower).card 1)
                                          (And (Eq (Finset.instInter.inter cap node.upper).card 3)
                                            (And (Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCupSet χ node.lower 5))
                                              (instLENat.le node.lower.card 20))))
                                        (And (Eq (Finset.instInter.inter cap node.lower).card 2)
                                          (And (Eq (Finset.instInter.inter cap node.upper).card 2)
                                            (Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCupSet χ node.lower 6)))))
                                      (ErdosSzekeres.HasSixPrivateRoutedTailTransversal χ upper cap
                                        tails tree path node))))))

doc:

  Eq support.card 32 →
    ∀ (hterminalCap : SetLike.instMembership.mem (ErdosSzekeres.capWitnesses χ support 4) terminal),
      (∀ (subset : Finset (Fin n)),
          Finset.instHasSubset.Subset subset support →
            Eq subset.card 23 → ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCapSet χ subset 4) →
        Not
            (Exists fun inner =>
              Exists fun hinner =>
                (ErdosSzekeres.finsetSweepInterval inner ⋯).StrictlyInside
                  (ErdosSzekeres.finsetSweepInterval terminal ⋯)) →
          ∀ (tree : ErdosSzekeres.DecompositionTree χ support) {path : List Bool}

              ErdosSzekeres.DecompositionTree.IsLowestSeparatingPath terminal tree path →
                (∀ (x : Fin n),
                    SetLike.instMembership.mem
                        (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff
                          (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff support
                            (ErdosSzekeres.openSweepSpanVertices support terminal ⋯))
                          terminal)
                        x →
                      Or
                        (ErdosSzekeres.RealizesCapFourFailureSignature χ terminal ⋯ x
                          ErdosSzekeres.CapFourFailureSignature.before)
                        (ErdosSzekeres.RealizesCapFourFailureSignature χ terminal ⋯ x
                          ErdosSzekeres.CapFourFailureSignature.after)) →
                  ErdosSzekeres.HasTwoRoutedSecondaryCaps χ support terminal
                    (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff

                        (ErdosSzekeres.openSweepSpanVertices support terminal ⋯))

doc:
The six essential routed tails yield either three private internal tails,
or three private external tails; every external selected tail has a certified
lower-directed first exit.
name: ErdosSzekeres.HasSixPrivateRoutedTailTransversal.three_internal_or_external
type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {support terminal tails : Finset (Fin n)}
  {tree : ErdosSzekeres.DecompositionTree χ support} {path : List Bool}
  {node : ErdosSzekeres.DecompositionSplit χ},
  ErdosSzekeres.HasSixPrivateRoutedTailTransversal χ support terminal tails tree path node →
    Exists fun transversal =>
      And (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset transversal tails)
        (And (ErdosSzekeres.HitsEveryFourCapDisjointFrom χ support terminal transversal)
          (And
            (∀ (x : Fin n),
              SetLike.instMembership.mem transversal x →
                Exists fun secondary =>
                  And
                    (SetLike.instMembership.mem (ErdosSzekeres.capWitnesses χ support 4) secondary)
                    (And (Disjoint terminal secondary)
                      (And (SetLike.instMembership.mem secondary x)
                        (Disjoint (transversal.erase x) secondary))))
            (Or
              (instLENat.le 3
                (Finset.instInter.inter transversal
                    (Finset.instUnion.union node.lower node.upper)).card)
              (And
                (instLENat.le 3
                  (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff transversal

doc:
The actual singleton-lower `(5,7,8)` obstruction has one terminal cap
carrying both its lowest-split alternative and a pair of globally supplied
secondary caps routed through distinct terminal tails.

type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {q : Fin n} {upper : Finset (Fin n)},
  ErdosSzekeres.IsDecomposableOn χ upper →
    ErdosSzekeres.HasDeepBelowSplit χ (Finset.instSingleton.singleton q) upper →
      Eq upper.card 32 →
        ErdosSzekeres.DecomposableStateUpper 5 5 8 →
          Not
              (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCapSet χ
                (Finset.instUnion.union (Finset.instSingleton.singleton q) upper) 5) →
            Not
                (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCupSet χ
                  (Finset.instUnion.union (Finset.instSingleton.singleton q) upper) 7) →
              Not
                  (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet χ
                    (Finset.instUnion.union (Finset.instSingleton.singleton q) upper) 8) →
                Exists fun cap =>
                  Exists fun hcap =>
                    And
                      (Not
                        (Exists fun inner =>
                          Exists fun hinner =>
                            (ErdosSzekeres.finsetSweepInterval inner ⋯).StrictlyInside
                              (ErdosSzekeres.finsetSweepInterval cap ⋯)))
                      (And ((ErdosSzekeres.finsetSweepInterval cap ⋯).StraddlesCut q.val)
                        (have tails :=
                          Finset.instSDiff.sdiff
                            (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff upper
                              (ErdosSzekeres.openSweepSpanVertices upper cap ⋯))
                            cap;
                        And (instLENat.le 9 tails.card)
                          (Exists fun tree =>
                            Exists fun path =>
                              Exists fun node =>
                                And (Eq (tree.splitAtPath path) (Option.some node))
                                  (And
                                    (ErdosSzekeres.DecompositionTree.IsLowestSeparatingPath cap tree
                                      path)
                                    (And
                                      (Or
                                        (And (Eq (Finset.instInter.inter cap node.lower).card 1)
                                          (And (Eq (Finset.instInter.inter cap node.upper).card 3)
                                            (And (Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCupSet χ node.lower 5))
                                              (instLENat.le node.lower.card 20))))
                                        (And (Eq (Finset.instInter.inter cap node.lower).card 2)
                                          (And (Eq (Finset.instInter.inter cap node.upper).card 2)
                                            (Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCupSet χ node.lower 6)))))
                                      (ErdosSzekeres.HasTwoRoutedSecondaryCaps χ upper cap tails
                                        tree path node))))))

type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {support terminal : Finset (Fin n)},
  Eq support.card 32 →
    ∀ (hterminalCap : SetLike.instMembership.mem (ErdosSzekeres.capWitnesses χ support 4) terminal),
      (∀ (subset : Finset (Fin n)),
          Finset.instHasSubset.Subset subset support →
            Eq subset.card 23 → ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCapSet χ subset 4) →
        Not
            (Exists fun inner =>
              Exists fun hinner =>
                (ErdosSzekeres.finsetSweepInterval inner ⋯).StrictlyInside
                  (ErdosSzekeres.finsetSweepInterval terminal ⋯)) →
          ∀ (tree : ErdosSzekeres.DecompositionTree χ support) {path : List Bool}
            {node : ErdosSzekeres.DecompositionSplit χ},
            Eq (tree.splitAtPath path) (Option.some node) →
              ErdosSzekeres.DecompositionTree.IsLowestSeparatingPath terminal tree path →
                (∀ (x : Fin n),
                    SetLike.instMembership.mem
                        (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff
                          (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff support
                            (ErdosSzekeres.openSweepSpanVertices support terminal ⋯))
                          terminal)
                        x →
                      Or
                        (ErdosSzekeres.RealizesCapFourFailureSignature χ terminal ⋯ x
                          ErdosSzekeres.CapFourFailureSignature.before)
                        (ErdosSzekeres.RealizesCapFourFailureSignature χ terminal ⋯ x
                          ErdosSzekeres.CapFourFailureSignature.after)) →
                  have tails :=
                    Finset.instSDiff.sdiff
                      (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff support
                        (ErdosSzekeres.openSweepSpanVertices support terminal ⋯))
                      terminal;
                  Exists fun first =>
                    Exists fun second =>
                      Exists fun x =>
                        Exists fun y =>
                          And
                            (SetLike.instMembership.mem (ErdosSzekeres.capWitnesses χ support 4)
                              first)
                            (And
                              (SetLike.instMembership.mem (ErdosSzekeres.capWitnesses χ support 4)
                                second)
                              (And (Disjoint terminal first)
                                (And (Disjoint terminal second)
                                  (And (Disjoint first second)
                                    (And (SetLike.instMembership.mem first x)
                                      (And (SetLike.instMembership.mem tails x)
                                        (And (SetLike.instMembership.mem second y)
                                          (And (SetLike.instMembership.mem tails y)
                                            (And (Ne x y)
                                              (And
                                                (ErdosSzekeres.IsInternalOrLowerFirstExit terminal x
                                                  tree path node)
                                                (ErdosSzekeres.IsInternalOrLowerFirstExit terminal y
                                                  tree path node)))))))))))

global minimum, either every cell is at-or-left, every cell is at-or-right, or

      ErdosSzekeres.AddressAtOrExtends578 (matrix.cell minimum.row minimum.column).path Bool.false

              And (Eq (matrix.cell i l).path (matrix.cell minimum.row minimum.column).path)

In the tight one-spine branch, the new unused three-boundary does not
magically hit the full residual family.  Instead density produces the exact
next witness: a residual cup disjoint from that boundary which necessarily
crosses from the unused eight vertices into the selected six-cap support.
Because the full address matrix indexes every residual cup, this witness is a
genuine new matrix row rather than an incidence-only proposal.

type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {q : Fin n} {reservoir : Finset (Fin n)}
  (joint : ErdosSzekeres.PrivateCupStarSixCapState578 χ reservoir),
  ErdosSzekeres.IsDecomposableOn χ reservoir →
    Eq reservoir.card 32 →
      Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCupSet χ reservoir 5) →
        Not
            (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCapSet χ
              (Finset.instUnion.union (Finset.instSingleton.singleton q) reservoir) 7) →
          Not
              (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet χ
                (Finset.instUnion.union (Finset.instSingleton.singleton q) reservoir) 8) →
            Eq (joint.saturation.state.packing.fullCupSpines joint.ledger.transversal).card 1 →
              Exists fun boundary =>
                And
                  (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset boundary
                    (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff reservoir joint.saturation.capSupport))
                  (And (instLENat.le boundary.card 3)
                    (And
                      (ErdosSzekeres.IsCupWitnessTransversal578 χ
                        (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff reservoir joint.saturation.capSupport) boundary 4)
                      (Exists fun cup =>
                        And
                          (SetLike.instMembership.mem
                            (joint.ledger.residualCupFamily
                              (joint.saturation.state.packing.fullCupProtected
                                joint.ledger.transversal))
                            cup)
                          (And (Disjoint cup boundary)
                            (And
                              (Not
                                (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset cup
                                  (Finset.instSDiff.sdiff reservoir joint.saturation.capSupport)))
                              (Finset.instInter.inter cup joint.saturation.capSupport).Nonempty)))))

entries and exact `32/23` density independently supplies two blocker-avoiding
cups with disjoint sweep-middle pairs.

the five selected fan rows.  The exact 13-vertex counterexample in

local identification or two-cover argument cannot be recovered from the
blocker and five rows alone.

blocker-avoiding family.  Unlike the residual matrix, the mixed branch cannot
be collapsed to a distinguished-row plateau because no row is known to meet

type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {support : Finset (Fin n)}
  {joint : ErdosSzekeres.PrivateCupStarSixCapState578 χ support}

  {matrix : ErdosSzekeres.BlockerAvoidingCupSixCapAddressMatrix578 joint tree blocker}
  (minimum : ErdosSzekeres.BlockerAvoidingCupSixCapCommonMinimum578 matrix),
  Or
    (And
      (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset joint.saturation.capSupport
        (matrix.cell minimum.row minimum.column).node.lower)
      (instLENat.le 24 (matrix.cell minimum.row minimum.column).node.lower.card))
    (Or
      (And
        (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset joint.saturation.capSupport
          (matrix.cell minimum.row minimum.column).node.upper)
        (instLENat.le 24 (matrix.cell minimum.row minimum.column).node.upper.card))
      (Or
        (Exists fun j =>
          ∀ (cup : ErdosSzekeres.BlockerAvoidingCupIndex578 joint blocker),
            Eq (matrix.cell cup j).path (matrix.cell minimum.row minimum.column).path)
        (Exists fun first =>
          Exists fun second =>
            Exists fun j =>
              Exists fun k =>
                Exists fun leftTail =>
                  Exists fun rightTail =>
                    And
                      (Eq (matrix.cell first j).path
                        (instHAppendOfAppend.hAppend (matrix.cell minimum.row minimum.column).path
                          (List.cons Bool.false leftTail)))
                      (And
                        (Eq (matrix.cell second k).path
                          (instHAppendOfAppend.hAppend (matrix.cell minimum.row minimum.column).path
                            (List.cons Bool.true rightTail)))
                        (And
                          (Eq (matrix.cell first k).path
                            (matrix.cell minimum.row minimum.column).path)
                          (Eq (matrix.cell second j).path
                            (matrix.cell minimum.row minimum.column).path))))))

type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {q : Fin n} {reservoir : Finset (Fin n)}

  ErdosSzekeres.IsDecomposableOn χ reservoir →
    Eq reservoir.card 32 →
      Not
          (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCapSet χ
            (Finset.instUnion.union (Finset.instSingleton.singleton q) reservoir) 7) →
        Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsCupSet χ reservoir 5) →

            Eq (joint.saturation.state.packing.fullCupSpines joint.ledger.transversal).card 1 →
              Exists fun boundary =>
                Exists fun cup =>
                  And
                    (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset boundary
                      (Finset.instUnion.union joint.star.spine seed.val))
                    (And (instLENat.le boundary.card 3)
                      (And
                        (SetLike.instMembership.mem
                          (joint.ledger.residualCupFamily
                            (joint.saturation.state.packing.fullCupProtected
                              joint.ledger.transversal))
                          cup)
                        (And (Disjoint cup boundary)
                          (Not
                            (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset cup
                              (Finset.instUnion.union joint.star.spine seed.val))))))

doc:
Same-parity distinct cyclic pools have a common linear rotation in
which their indices are nonadjacent.  The second disjunct of the proof uses
the reverse rotation for cyclic distance `2 * r - 2`.

type_pp:
∀ {P : Finset (ErdosSzekeres.Point 2)} {r : Nat}
  (_h : ErdosSzekeres.PorValtrSupportProductData P r),
  instLENat.le 3 r →
    ErdosSzekeres.InGeneralPosition P →
      ∀ (i j : Fin (instHMul.hMul 2 r)),
        Eq (instHMod.hMod i.val 2) (instHMod.hMod j.val 2) →
          Ne i j →
            Exists fun start =>
              Exists fun a =>
                Exists fun b =>
                  And (Eq (instHMod.hMod (instHAdd.hAdd start.val a.val) (instHMul.hMul 2 r)) i.val)
                    (And
                      (Eq (instHMod.hMod (instHAdd.hAdd start.val b.val) (instHMul.hMul 2 r)) j.val)
                      (Or (instLTNat.lt (instHAdd.hAdd a.val 1) b.val)
                        (instLTNat.lt (instHAdd.hAdd b.val 1) a.val)))

ErdosSzekeres.SukPositiveFractionParameters.recOn
type_pp:
{n s : Nat} →
  {motive : ErdosSzekeres.SukPositiveFractionParameters n s → Sort u} →
    (t : ErdosSzekeres.SukPositiveFractionParameters n s) →
      ((poolLengthLower : instLENat.le 13 (ErdosSzekeres.sukPoolLength s)) →
          (chainSizePositive : instLENat.le 1 (ErdosSzekeres.sukChainThreshold n s)) →
            (antichainSizePositive : instLENat.le 1 (ErdosSzekeres.sukAntichainThreshold n s)) →
              (separatedCountPositive : instLENat.le 1 (ErdosSzekeres.sukSeparatedCount s)) →
                (scaleLower : instLENat.le 2 s) →
                  (poolLengthCovers :
                      instLENat.le
                        (instHMul.hMul
                          (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul 2 (ErdosSzekeres.sukSeparatedCount s)) 1) s)
                        (ErdosSzekeres.sukPoolLength s)) →
                    (carryWidthLower : instLENat.le 2 (ErdosSzekeres.sukCarryWidth n s)) →
                      (finalDeficit :
                          instLENat.le 2
                            (instHSub.hSub n
                              (instHMul.hMul (instHSub.hSub s 1)
                                (ErdosSzekeres.sukCarryWidth n s)))) →
                        (finalSize :
                            instLENat.le n (instHMul.hMul s (ErdosSzekeres.sukCarryWidth n s))) →
                          (chainCard :
                              ∀ (u : Nat),
                                instLTNat.lt u s →
                                  instLTNat.lt
                                    ((instHSub.hSub
                                          (instHAdd.hAdd n (ErdosSzekeres.sukCarryWidth n s))
                                          4).choose
                                      (instHSub.hSub
                                        (instHMul.hMul (instHAdd.hAdd u 1)
                                          (ErdosSzekeres.sukCarryWidth n s))
                                        2))
                                    (ErdosSzekeres.sukChainThreshold n s)) →
                            (localCapSizeLower :
                                instLENat.le 2 (ErdosSzekeres.sukLocalCapSize n s)) →
                              (antichainThreshold :
                                  instLTNat.lt
                                    ((instHSub.hSub
                                          (instHAdd.hAdd n (ErdosSzekeres.sukLocalCapSize n s))
                                          4).choose
                                      (instHSub.hSub n 2))
                                    (ErdosSzekeres.sukAntichainThreshold n s)) →
                                (antichainTotal :
                                    instLENat.le n
                                      (instHMul.hMul (ErdosSzekeres.sukSeparatedCount s)
                                        (ErdosSzekeres.sukLocalCapSize n s))) →
                                  (fineThreshold :
                                      instLENat.le
                                        (instHMul.hMul 2
                                          (ErdosSzekeres.porValtrFineDenominator
                                            (ErdosSzekeres.sukPoolLength s)))
                                        (ErdosSzekeres.sukPositiveFractionThreshold n s)) →
                                    (coarseThreshold :
                                        instLENat.le
                                          (instHMul.hMul
                                            (ErdosSzekeres.sukCoarseDenominator
                                              (ErdosSzekeres.sukPoolLength s))
                                            (instHAdd.hAdd
                                              (instHMul.hMul
                                                (instHSub.hSub (ErdosSzekeres.sukChainThreshold n s)
                                                  1)
                                                (instHSub.hSub
                                                  (ErdosSzekeres.sukAntichainThreshold n s) 1))
                                              1))
                                          (ErdosSzekeres.sukPositiveFractionThreshold n s)) →
                                      motive ⋯) →
        motive t

type_pp:
And (Eq (Fintype.card (ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.SignVector 3)) 8)
  (And (Eq ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.cutCE.card 6)
    (And
      (Not
        (SetLike.instMembership.mem ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.cutCE
          ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.x))
      (And
        (SetLike.instMembership.mem ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.cutCE ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.u)
        (And
          (SetLike.instMembership.mem ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.cutCE
            ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.v)
          (And
            (ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.cubeAdjacent ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.x
              ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.u)
            (And
              (ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.cubeAdjacent ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.x
                ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.v)
              (And
                (Eq
                  (ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.cubeGraphDistance ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.x
                    ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.u)
                  1)
                (And
                  (Eq
                    (ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.cubeGraphDistance ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.x
                      ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.v)
                    1)
                  (And
                    (Eq
                      (ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.cubeGraphDistance ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.u
                        ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.v)
                      2)
                    (And
                      (Not
                        (Exists fun g =>
                          ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.IsGate ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.cutCE
                            ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.x g))
                      (Not
                        (ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.IsGated
                          ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.cutCE))))))))))))

name: ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.threePointAffineTopeReturnBridge
type_pp:
And
  (ErdosSzekeres.IsSweepRealizable
    ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.threePointConfiguration.tripleColoring)
  (And
    (Not
      (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet
        ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.threePointConfiguration.tripleColoring Finset.univ 4))
    (And
      (ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.StrongPredecessorEdge
        ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.threePointConfiguration.tripleColoring 4 Finset.univ)
      (And
        (Eq
          (ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.affineTopes
            ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.threePointConfiguration)
          Set.univ)
        (And
          (ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.AffineTopeConnected
            ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.threePointConfiguration)
          (And
            (∀
              (σ τ :
                ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.AffineTope
                  ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.threePointConfiguration),
              Eq
                (ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.affineTopeGraphDistance
                  ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.threePointConfiguration
                  ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.threePoint_affineTopeConnected σ τ)
                (ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.cubeGraphDistance σ.val τ.val))
            (And
              (Eq
                (ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.affineCutCE
                  ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.threePointConfiguration Finset.univ)
                (Set.preimage
                  (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.threePointTopeEquiv)
                  (Finset.instSetLike.coe ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.cutCE)))
              (Iff
                (ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.AffineTopeIsGated
                  ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.threePointConfiguration
                  ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.threePoint_affineTopeConnected
                  (ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.affineCutCE
                    ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.threePointConfiguration Finset.univ))
                (ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.IsGated ErdosSzekeres.TopeHellyCube.cutCE))))))))
